Knorpel: Fokal bis vollschichtige Chondropathie retropatellar am Patellafirst (4/12 + 14). An der Trochlea ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz. Ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz an der medialen Femurkondyle im Femorotibialgelenk, fokal mit bis vollschichtiger Chondropathie (6/11+ 5/21). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. 
Kreuzbänder: Intakte Darstellung des Faserverlauf sowie Signalgebung des hinteren Kreuzbandes. Kräftiges anteriores meniscofemorales Ligament. Intakter Verlauf des vorderen Kreuzbandes.
Menisci: Mucoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskusvorderhornes, geringer mucoide Degeneration am Innenmeniskushinterhorn. Keine Rissbildung oder Herniation. Keine parameniscealen Zysten.

Fettkörper: Unauffällig, kein raumfordernder Prozess. 
Weichteile: CC bis 8 cm ausgedehnte polylobulierte Baker-Zyste in Loco typico (6/5, 5/33).

Popliteal fossa:  Normal.

Other findings:  Mild subcutaneous edema mostly over the lateral aspect of the knee. Fatty atrophy of the medial gastrocnemius muscle.

The lateral compartment is completely attenuated with bone-on-bone articulation and extensive degenerative changes. The lateral meniscus is nearly completely extruded and macerated, consistent with with an extensive complex degenerative tear.

Oblique tear of the posterior medial meniscus with inferior articular surfacing. 

Mild patellofemoral and medial compartment degenerative changes. Small joint effusion.

original_report: МР находка: Наличие на минимално количество ставен излив. Ставният хрущял на пателата е значително изтънен до липсващ. По горния и долния ръб на същата се виждат остеофитни наслагвания, а в нейната структура и зони на костномозъчен едем във връзка с дегенеративните изменения в ретропателарната става. Зад задната кръстна връзка се вижда овална лезия с костноеквивалентна сигнална характеристика и размери 10,5/4,7мм. Лезия с идентична структура се вижда вътреставно медиолатерално отпред пред предната кръстна връзка и големина 17,8/8мм. Трета подобна лезия се открива дорзално до медиалния фемурален кондил с големина 7мм. Находките съответстват на вътреставни мишки. В хрущяла на фемура вентрално и медиално под нивото на пателата се виждат дефекти, без данни за костномозъчен едем субхондрално. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна на ставата се лекостепенно изтънен. Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec un petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

1. Changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminent au niveau patellofémoral tel que détaillé ci-haut.

2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance des ménisques avec déchirure horizontale surajoutée du ménisque interne tel que détaillé ci-haut.

> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon and mild subcutaneous infiltration over right knee.
> Small hyperintensity lesion in subchondral region of right distal femur, R/O fibrocystic chnage.

1. Osteoarthritis of right knee with grade 3-4 chondromalacia and subchondral edema.
2. Synovitis of right knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
3. Large Baker's cyst with perifocal edema.
4. R/O small fibrocystic chnage in distal femur. (Srs/Img: 5/9-10)
5. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 9 week history of right knee pain without known injury. [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with minimal synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage defect weightbearing lateral femoral condyle. Full-thickness cartilage defect lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal chondrosis at the superior median patellar ridge and lateral patellar facet with subchondral bone marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: There is edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is lateral patellar tilt and translation in part related to large joint effusion. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Mild prepatellar soft tissue edema.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Large joint effusion with minimal synovitis. Consider aspiration.
2.	Mild patellofemoral and moderate lateral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Findings of active lateral patellar maltracking.

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is no popliteal cysts.

There are moderate degenerative changes most pronounced medially. More specifically there is moderate cartilage thinning in the medial compartment most pronounced at the central weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with mild subchondral reactive changes. There is also moderate cartilage thinning at the medial patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral reactive changes. There are mild changes in the lateral compartment.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is complete radial tear of the posterior root with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate degenerative changes most pronounced medially.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial meniscus with complete radial tear of the posterior root and meniscal extrusion.

3. Knee joint effusion with synovitis without popliteal cyst. à

original_report:
There is proximal non avulsive disruption of the anterior cruciate ligament, with some anteriorly displaced fragments being best appreciated in the sagittal plane.  
Marrow contusional changes are noted at the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, also affecting the posteromedial and posterolateral tibial plateaux - the overall pattern being compatible with a pivot shift mechanism of injury.  
There is a significant resultant suprapatellar effusion with associated synovitis.  There are no convincing medial or lateral meniscal tears. A grade 1 proximal MCL injury is noted. There is furthermore a posteromedial meniscocapsular sprain. 
No posterolateral corner injury is identified, nor is there any injury to the anterolateral ligament. 
Normal PCL, lateral collateral ligament, popliteus musculotendinous unit and PTFL, distal iliotibial band and extensor tendons. Well-preserved tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.  
The extent of fluid signal intensity within the deep posterior soft tissues following injury suggests prior posterior capsular disruption.

4. Anserine bursitis with perifocal soft tissue edema; subcutaneous edema over left knee.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Moderate joint effusion with mild synovial thickening. Tiny amount of fluid in the pes anserine bursa. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
There is a peripheral vertical tear involving the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. It is located 3 mm from meniscocapsular junction.
Mild diffuse cartilage fraying with focal partial-thickness cartilage fissuring at the medial femoral articular surface without subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.
Mild thickening of the proximal medial collateral ligament injury with mild superficial edema, suggesting healing low-grade sprain.
Mild tendinosis of the semimembranosus tendon near its femoral insertion.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
No tear of the lateral meniscus.
Mild thinning of the lateral femoral condyle cartilage without full-thickness chondral loss. No subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.
Abnormal thickening of the distal conjoint ligament, suggesting a subacute low-grade injury.
There is edema of the popliteus muscle with a small intramuscular cystic change, in keeping with grade 2 strain. Its tendon remains within normal limits without tear.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
There is complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament in its midportion. The posterior cruciate ligament is normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Deep cartilage fissuring in the medial and lateral facets patella without subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.
Unremarkable extensor tendons and patellar retinacula.

Bones:
Bone contusions in the posterior aspect of the bilateral tibial plateau.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
As above.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2.Vertical peripheral tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
3.Low-grade subacute injury of the medial collateral ligament and distal conjoined lateral ligament.
4.Grade 2 injury of the popliteus muscle belly without tendon tear.

Prikaže se hondromalacija II-III° artikulacijskih hrskavica FT zgloba medijalno.
Degenerativno promijenjeno tijelo i stražnji rog medijalnog meniska uz horizontalnu i suspektnu
kosu rupturu u području stražnjeg roga te znakove parcijalne meniskokapsularne separacije od
posteromedijalne čahure s kranijalne strane. Nalazi se blaga ekstruzija medijalnog meniska koji
potiskuje medijalni kolateralni ligament uz periligamentarni edem.

Promijenjen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u smislu degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova
rupture. Uz prednji korijen nalaze se dvije parameniscealne ciste promjera do 3 mm.
Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, blaže promijenjenih intenziteta signala u smislu
degenerativnih promjena.
Povišen intenzitet signala proksimalne trećine stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, može odgovarati
degenerativnim promjenama ili stanju po parcijalnoj rupturi. Uz tibijalno hvatište nalazi se
nekoliko sitnih ganglion cisti promjera do 2 mm.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Hondromalacija I-III° medijalne fasete patele i trohleje femura.
Hondromalacija II° lateralne fasete patele.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Tendinopatski promijenjena tetiva m. semimembranosusa na hvatištu za tibiju.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni ligament blago povišenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta, u smislu
entezopatksih promjena.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.
Prepatelarno manji potkožni edem.

Patella minimal lateralisiert. Ansonsten unauffällig. Unauffälliger Knorpelbelag femoropatellar.
Femorotibial ebenfalls unauffälliger Knorpelbelag ohne Nachweis einer Chondropathie. Außen- und Innenmeniskus intakt. Das hintere Kreuzband unauffällig. Das vordere Kreuzband deutlich signalangehoben mit geringem Tonusverlust (z. B. 5/16) und nicht sicher durchgehend abgrenzbar.
V. a. Partialläsion des MCL bei femoralseitig deutlicher Signalanhebung der ventralen Anteile (4/18 oder 7/12). Geringe Flüssigkeit um das LCL, dieses ansonsten durchgehend abgrenzbar. Moderater Gelenkerguss. Plica mediopatellaris (Typ A). Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis. Fabella.

Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Geringer Gelenkerguss. Regelrechtes Flow-void in den erfassten Gefäßen.

Constatations:

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré, avec suspicion d'un niveau graisseux au versant externe suggérant un degré de lipohémarthrose. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du creux poplité et de la portion supérieure de la patte d'oie. 

Il y a un émoussement du rebord postérieur de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suspect d'une déchirure longitudinale verticale périphérique potentielle. Il y a également une extrusion relativement significative du corps méniscal, le plus probablement en lien avec une déchirure complète du ligament collatéral interne. 

Il y a une déchirure complète du ligament colléral interne distal avec rétraction proximale des fibres déchirées, associées à de multiples zones d'irrégularités, épaississements et signal anormal intra-substance. Il y également une atténuation et signal intra-substance à son origine. La partie distale du ligament collatéral interne déchirée se situe légèrement sous les tendons de la patte d'oie constituant une lésion de type ''pseudo Stener''. Il y a également une déchire complète de la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale et une déchirure partielle de la composante ménisco-tibiale. 

Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante fémorotibiale interne.

Le ménisque externe est intact sans déchirure. Il y a une petite fracture au versant supérieur de la tête du péroné potentiellement à l'insertion du ligament poplité arqué. Minime déplacement et œdème associés. L'insertion distale du ligament collatéral externe et du tendon du biceps est préservé de même que l'origine. Il y a également une petite ossification au versant postérieur de la tête du péroné mesurant 5 mm, d'origine indéterminée. 

Il y a des irrégularités de l'os sous-chondral à la surface portante du condyle fémoral externe d'allure plutôt chronique. Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante fémorotibiale externe. Toutefois, petit foyer d'œdème au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe avec léger hypersignal chondral, contusion versus lésion oséto-chondrale (atypique) versus changement de stress en lien avec l’origine du gastrocnémien externe. 

Kyste ganglionnaire à l'origine des deux gastrocnémiens.

Il y a une déchirure d'allure complète à l'insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur et/ou avulsion du LCP. Le ligament est rétracté proximalement, épaissi et de signal anormal. Il y a une atténuation significative du ligament croisé antérieur sans composante transfixiante toutefois notée, en lien avec une déchirure partielle. Il y a des contusions probablement associées au plateau tibial externe, plus marquées en postérieur +/- impaction/fracture sous-chondrale.

Petit kyste ganglionnaire à l'empreinte distale du ligament croisé antérieur.

L'alignement patello-fémoral demeure dans les limites normales. Séquelles de maladie Osgood Schlatter avec fragmentation d'allure chronique de la tubérosité tibiale et léger épaississement du tendon rotulien. Le tendon du quadriceps distal est intact sans déchirure. Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante patello-fémorale. La graisse de Hoffa est sans grande particularité.

Il y a un œdème diffus significatif sous-cutané et inter-musculaire. Il y a également un œdème des muscles poplité et plantaire en lien avec une entorse.

Conclusion:

Déchirure complète du ligament collatéral interne distal avec déplacement de la portion distale sous les tendons de la patte d'oie en lien avec une lésion de type 'pseudo Stener''. Il y a également une déchirure complète de la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale et partielle de la composante ménisco-tibiale.

Déchirure d'allure complète du ligament croisé postérieur distal et/ou avulsion du LCP. Déchirure partielle probable du ligament croisé antérieur.

Fracture au versant supérieur de la tête du péroné probablement à l'insertion du ligament poplité arqué. Œdème associé.

De plus, contusions probable du plateau tibial externe +/- impaction/fracture sous-chondrale et du versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe. 

Émoussement du rebord postérieur de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suspect d'une déchirure longitudinale verticale périphérique potentielle.

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré avec composante de lipohémarthrose suspectée.

Dans ce contexte, un complément d'investigation par tomodensitométrie est recommandé pour mieux évaluer les structures osseuses. De plus, une consultation en chirurgie orthopédique est également, fortement recommandée. 

Le rapport a été transcrit en priorité.

original_report: Bei Z. n. Patellaluxation die Patella aktuell noch etwas inkongruent gering lateralisiert stehend. Flache Trochlea (4/72). Unauffällige Patella-Form. Am ehesten postkontusionelles Bone Bruise an der Außenseite der lateralen Femurkondyle (4/79) sowie dezent auch anterior am lateralen Tibia-Plateau (5/19). Kein eindeutiges Bone Bruise an der Patella. Der retropatellare Knorpelbelag mit einzelnen tief greifenden bis auf Knochenniveau reichenden fissuralen Läsionen, exemplarisch an der medialen Facette (8/11) sowie auch an der lateralen Facette (8/10). Ansonsten überwiegend oberflächliche Fibrillationen, betont an der medialen Facette. Unauffällige Darstellung der Menisken. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Das LCL am Ursprung gering aufgetrieben und signalangehoben (5/25), DD bei kleiner Partialläsion. Deutlicher Hämarthros. Diffuse Einblutungen in die umgebende Subcutis. В задният рог на този менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответсваща на скъсване. Скъсването видимо достига до задния край на менискуса, но не и до ставните краища на фумра и тибията. Няма данни за ставен излив. Предната кръстна връзка е с уголемен напречник и повишен интензитет на сигнала. Находката е както при частично скъсване на връзката с давност. Нормално изобразяване на задната кръстна връзка. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о.  Патела, ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Il y a un épanchement articulaire petit à modéré. Il y a un kyste poplité qui mesure jusqu’à 4.7 x 3.1 x 2.6cm de diamètre.

Le cartilage fémoro-rotulien est normal. Il n’y a pas de chondrose significative.

Le ménisque interne démontre des signes de dégénérescence mixoïde. Il n’y a pas de déchirure.

Le ménisque externe parait normal.

Le ligament croisé antérieur est normal.

Le ligament croisé postérieur démontre une déchirure longitudinale et partielle paraissant ancienne.

Le complexe ligamentaire externe est normal.

Le ligament collatéral interne est épaissi à la sa partie supérieure avec irrégularité de contour suggestif d’une ancienne blessure grade 1-2. Il n’y a pas de déchirure significative.

Il n’y a pas de contusion osseuse d’œdème de la moelle osseuse ou de fracture. Il n’y a pas de blessure ostéochondrale.

Il n’y a pas de chondrose ou d’arthrose significative au niveau des compartiments tibio-fémoral interne ou externe.

Le reste de l’examen est sans particularité.

Conclusion :

Déchirure partielle ancienne du ligament croisé postérieur. Une corrélation clinique est recommandée quant à sa stabilité.

Ancienne blessure grade 1-2 du ligament collatéral interne. Pas d’évidence de déchirure significative.

Épanchement articulaire petit à modéré avec présence d’un kyste poplité tel que décrit plus.

Autres observations faites, voir rapport plus haut.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for 2 to 3 months. No known injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Moderate leaking multilobulated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear with dominant radial component at the posterior root. Severe meniscal extrusion. No displaced meniscal flap or fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: Confluent regions of high-grade articular cartilage loss at both sides of the weightbearing aspect of the joint, including some areas of full-thickness fissuring and associated subchondral signal changes. High-grade cartilage loss at the posterior medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity and high-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint with regions of full-thickness fissuring and associated subchondral signal changes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage loss at the patella, including areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at the median ridge, medial patellar facet, and lateral patellar facet. Full-thickness chondral fissuring at the medial and lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear. Small intrasubstance ganglion formation at the tibial insertion.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 11 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:

Interprétation : 

Il y a un minime liséré de liquide au sein du récessus suprapatellaire, sans épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. Il y a un petit kyste de Baker, sans complication significative, mesurant 2,8 cm de diamètre CC.

Il y a une déchirure longitudinale horizontale impliquant la corne postérieure et le corps du ménisque interne, s’étendant à la racine postérieure, à la jonction avec la corne antérieure et le long de la surface articulaire inférieure. Il y a de petits kystes paraméniscaux associés au versant postérieur. 

Il y a un épaississement des fibres superficielles du ligament collatéral interne avec un œdème léger à modéré au pourtour suggérant une entorse de grade 1. 

Il y a une atténuation légère à modérée des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémorotibial interne , sans atteinte transfixiante. Il y a de petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Le ménisque externe et le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts et sans déchirure.

Il y a une légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémorotibial externe avec un foyer de chondropathie sévère à la surface non-portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe avec une perte focale transfixiante de la surface cartilagineuse et un début de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Il y a de minimes ostéophytes marginaux.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts et sans déchirure. Il y a de minimes kyste ganglionnaires intra-osseux sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé antérieur. 

L’alignement patellofémoral parait dans les limites de la normale. Il y a plusieurs artéfacts de susceptibilité magnétique au versant antérieur du tendon patellaire, le plus probablement de nature post-interventionnel/chirurgical; à corréler cliniquement. 

Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont grossièrement intacts et sans déchirure. 

Il y a un léger épaississement prépatellaire qui pourrait être en lien avec des séquelles de bursite.

Il y a une légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patellofémoral, principalement à la surface trochléaire avec des foyers de chondropathie sévère le long de l’échancrure intercondylienne et de la facette trochléaire externe avec fissures transfixiantes et des changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Il y a de petits ostéophytes marginaux. 

Il y a des microkystes ganglionnaires millimétriques en lien avec l’articulation tibiofibulaire proximale.

Conclusion :

Déchirure longitudinale horizontale de la corne postérieure et du corps du ménisque interne telle que décrite ci-haut avec de petits kystes paraméniscaux associés au versant postérieur.

Entorse de grade 1 du ligament collatéral interne. 

Changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentale avec des foyers de chondropathie sévère à la surface non-portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe et le long de la surface trochléaire au compartiment patellofémoral. 

Pas d'épanchement intra-articulaire significatif.

Petit kyste de Baker non-compliqué.

Autres trouvailles telles que décrites ci-haut.

original_report:
FINDINGS:

Fractures:
None.

Joint alignment:
Normal.

Degenerative changes:
Focal high to full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral femoral condyle and tibia posteriorly. This is most likely related to a prior osteochondral injury.

Mild cartilage loss in the patellofemoral cartilage with thinning of the patellar cartilage inferiorly.

Bone marrow signal:
Normal. Subchondral cysts involving the lateral tibial plateau.

Anterior cruciate ligament: Mild signal abnormality involving the ACL ligament at the posterior insertion to the femur, likely related to a mild sprain.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Normal.
Medial collateral ligament: Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: The fibular collateral ligament, IT band and biceps femoris are intact. Signal abnormality involving the popliteus tendon insertion at the lateral femoral condyle, most likely tendinosis. The popliteomeniscal fascicles are not well seen and likely torn, with associated mild medial displacement of the popliteus tendon below the popliteus hiatus.

Medial meniscus: Normal.
Lateral meniscus: Complex multidirectional tear involving the posterior, body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is volume loss in the body and a large displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. There is complete loss of tissue in the posterior horn, likely a complete radial tear. There is unusual U shaped fragment adjacent to the posterior root ligament.

Extensor mechanism: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Normal.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corner: Normal.

Joint effusion: Small to moderate right knee joint effusion, with synovial thickening. There is a small loose body in the suprapatellar recess measuring approximately 3 mm.
Baker cyst: None.

Other significant findings:
None.

CONCLUSION:
*Complex multidirectional tear of the body, posterior and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus, with a large unusually shaped displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. Recommend an orthopedic surgery consultation.
*Mild signal abnormality of the ACL, likely from a sprain, without evidence of tear.
*Focal high to full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral compartment posteriorly, most significantly the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

Наличие на ставна течност на мястото на лизирания хрущял. Виждат се малки зони на субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондул на фемура и тибията. Виждат се остеофити от медиалната страна на ставата. Ставните хрущяли от латералната страна на ставата и на пателата са съхранени. МР данни за ставен излив. Вижда се голяма Бекерова киста с размер 60/22мм. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на този меникус е уголемен и е с повишен сигнален интензитет. В него се намират хиперинтензни линии, съответстващи на скъсване. Скъсването достига до задния край на меникускуса и до ставните повърхности на фемура и на тибията. Дегенеративни промени се откриват и в прения рог на латералния менискус, без видимо скъсване в него. Предната кръстна връзка е с изтънн напречник – находка съответсваща на частично скъсване с давност. Налричие на малка зона на отоко на костния мозък в тибията под залавното място на предната кръстна връзка. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилие на м квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Заключение: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Детенеративни промени в меникусите. Фрагментиран е задният рог на медиалния менискус. Частично скъсване с давност на предната кръстна връзка. Ставен излив. Бекерова киста.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarne
tetive i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna ruptura korpusa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska, s "flap" komponentom koja se
prebacuje iznad stražnjeg roga meniska u području korijena. Korpus meniska periferno je
potisnut.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Reaktivni periligamentarni edem uz medijalni kolateralni ligament.
Fisure i defekti pune debljine hrskavice obje fasete patele (hondromalacija 3. stupnja prema
ICRS klasifikaciji),  uz sitne rubne osteofite - OA promjene.
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice prožete su plitkim fisurama (hondromalacija 2. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji), uz sitne rubne osteofite FT zgloba - OA promjene.
Koštani edem medijalnog kondila tibije.
Enhondrom u lateralnom aspektu distalne metafize femura promjera 13 mm.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu, masivna poplitealna (Bakerova) cista uz koju se nalazi subfascijalna
slobodna tekućina uz stražnji rub m. gastroknemijusa. Opisano je suspektno na rupturu
Bakerove ciste, bez potpune drenaže njenog sadržaja.
Varikoziteti potkožnih vena poplitealno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild degenerative subchondral cystic changes and edema are present at the lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. Mild cystic changes are present at the tibial spines. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a large, complex tear involving the anterior horn and body, extending to the posterior horn, with moderate extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate to severe cartilage loss is present, most prominent at the posterior aspect. Small osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the trochlea diffusely, with a chondral flap at the lateral trochlear facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with evidence of chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Lateral meniscal tear with extrusion.
2. Chondrosis in the patellofemoral and lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.
4. Moderate Baker cyst.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Few day history of knee pain following skiing injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osteochondral impaction injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau. Low-grade osseous contusion along the posteromedial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate hemarthrosis. Disruption of the posterolateral joint capsule with edema tracking along the posterior knee interfascial planes. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear involving the body and posterior horn medial meniscus without extrusion or displaced fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle towards the intercondylar notch.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade near full-thickness cartilage loss along the median ridge-medial patellar facet junction with overhanging edges. Trochlear cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete ACL tear with torn fibers along the anterior intercondylar notch.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 sprain characterized by periligamentous edema without fiber disruption.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: There is low-grade partial-thickness tearing involving the distal conjoint tendon and partial tearing of the popliteofibular ligament.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Suspected partial tearing of the MPFL at the medial patellar attachment with superimposed disruption of the medial patellar retinaculum.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is marked lateral patellar translation and mild lateral patellar tilt. Patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complete ACL tear with associated osteochondral impaction injury of the posterolateral tibial plateau and osseous contusion at the posteromedial tibial plateau. 
2.	Lateral patellar subluxation possibly sequela of lateral patellar dislocation with partial disruption of the MPFL and medial patellar retinaculum. Additional near full-thickness focal cartilage defect at the median ridge and medial patellar facet possibly posttraumatic.
3.	Oblique undersurface tear posterior horn and body medial meniscus without displaced fragment or extrusion.
4.	Grade 1 sprain of the MCL.
5.	Grade 1 to low-grade 2 sprain of the distal conjoint tendon and popliteofibular ligament at the posterolateral corner. 
6.	Moderate hemarthrosis.

FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion. There is significant soft tissue swelling surrounding the knee.

There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. There is thickening and increased signal involving the distal posterior cruciate ligament with partial tear (approximately 50% of the fibers) of the posterior medial fibers. There is mild thickening and increased signal involving the proximal and mid aspect of the PCL.

There is complete radial tear of the posterior root of the lateral meniscus. The medial meniscus is unremarkable.

There is complete tear of the medial collateral ligament with distal avulsion of the superficial component which is retracted proximally and superficial to the pes anserine tendons compatible with a pseudoStener lesion. There is also high-grade injury involving the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial component of the MCL with thickening of the posterior oblique ligament.

There is almost complete tear of the lateral collateral ligament at its femoral attachment. There are thinned out fibers that appear physically continuous. This is likely a functionally complete tear. There is also almost complete tear of the popliteus tendon as it courses around the lateral femoral condyle with significant thinning and laxity of the tendon. There is disruption of the popliteal fibular ligament. The distal biceps femoris insertion remains intact.

There is significant bone marrow edema at the posterior tibial plateau fractures. There is also bone contusion involving the anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and minimal contusion at the medial femoral condyle.

There is an enchondroma in the distal femur.

CONCLUSION:

1. Complete tear of the ACL with a moderate grade injury of the PCL.

2. High-grade injury involving the medial collateral ligament including distal avulsion of the superficial MCL with pseudo Stener lesion.

3. High-grade tear of the lateral collateral ligament which is likely functionally complete.

4. Almost complete tear of the popliteus tendon. Injury to the popliteal fibular ligament.

5. Complete radial tear involving the posterior root of the lateral meniscus.

6. Significant bone marrow edema surrounding the known tibial plateau fracture with a bone contusion in the lateral femoral condyle.

7. large knee joint effusion.

МР данни за дегенеративни промени на преден рог на латерален менискус. Пред него се изобразява многокамерна кистична лезия с овална форма и размери 14/6мм, съответстваща на вътреставна гнаглион киста, в ДД- по-малко вероятно е да се касае за менискусова киста. Вижда се и малка Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус. Заключение: МР данни за руптура на предна кръстна връзка. Вътреставен излив. Patelarni retinakulumi održani, vretenasto zadebljani moguće posljedično stanju nakon

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Several week history of left knee pain after fall. Pain localized laterally. No prior surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Mild degenerative subchondral cystic change at the anterior margin of the medial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. 

JOINT SPACE:
Minimal joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear involving the posterior body-horn junction and posterior horn medial meniscus with superimposed small 3 mm intrameniscal cyst formation of the posterior horn. Moderate extrusion of the body partially displaced within the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: Scattered areas of low grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle and along the anterior medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the anterior weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss involving the lateral patellar facet. Trochlear cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 2 sprain of the fibular collateral ligament proximally near the femoral attachment characterized by high-grade partial-thickness tearing and fiber irregularity and surrounding peritendinous edema. The iliotibial band, biceps femoris and popliteus tendon are intact. Popliteofibular ligament appears intact.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Moderate prepatellar subcutaneous soft tissue edema and non organized fluid, may reflect underlying soft tissue contusion in the setting of fall. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	High-grade 2 sprain involving the proximal fibular collateral ligament, remaining posterolateral corner structures are intact.
2.	Oblique undersurface tear posterior body and posterior horn medial meniscus with moderate meniscal extrusion and partial displacement within the meniscotibial recess.
3.	Mild tricompartmental chondrosis.
4.	Small Baker cyst.
5.	Moderate anterior soft tissue edema likely representing contusion.

2. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; R/O parameniscal cyst; differential diagnosis of  MCL bursitis.
3. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
4. C/W osteoarthritis of right knee joint and mild synovitis.
5. Infrapatellar fat pad edema.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 2 years. No known injury. No history of knee surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Marginal osteophytosis at the patellofemoral compartment. Button osteophyte at the medial femoral condyle.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Diminutive medial meniscus with blunting of the free edge of the meniscal body. Displaced meniscal fragment to the posterior joint recess. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade articular cartilage loss throughout the medial patellar facet with regions of full-thickness chondral fissuring at the median ridge. Full-thickness chondral fissuring at the medial and central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis. Retro-quadriceps fat pad edema. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 14 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with displaced meniscal fragment at the posterior joint recess.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral compartment and mild medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis. 
3.	Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.
4.	Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha.
Hallazgos:
Formación quística subcortical del aspecto anterior del platillo tibial medial de 7 x 6 mm en sus
ejes mayores, sin significado patológico específico.
No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Cartílago
troclear sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano su faceta
lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Aumento de señal de la inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Bone marrow signal is normal. No acute fracture or bone bruise. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. A lobulated ganglion cyst arises from the anterior joint capsule, and extends into Hoffa's fat pad. No Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn extending to the body, with moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning is present at the weightbearing aspect diffusely. Small osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a complex tear at the posterior root attachment, with mild extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the central and posterior aspect. Small osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Trochlear cartilage appears intact. Small osteophytes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with evidence of chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Patella alta is present. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear.
2. Tricompartmental chondrosis.
3. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.
4. Ganglion cyst within Hoffa's fat pad.

MRI of Left Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Screen Save

*  Increased signal intensity in ACL on F/S T2WI, R/O grade 1 injury.
*  Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface and meniscal root and protrusion of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
   There are linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extends into the surface , R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal.
* Fluid accmulation around medial head of gastrocnemius muscle and synovial bursa, r/o gastrocnemius bursitis.
* Fluid accumulation in the posterior articular capsule to retrocruciate ligament recess.
* Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, reflecting Anserine bursitis
* Increased signal intensity in F/S T2WI at tibial medial condyle, bone marrow edema is considered.
* A lobulated cystic lesion in popliteal fossa with a small recess of the knee joint capsule lies medially between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of small Baker's cyst.
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
* Subchondral cysts noted in the intercondylar eminence of proximal tibia and spur formation, in favor of degeneration.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> The contour of PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of medial compartment and spur formation and mild subchondral bone marrow edema over medial tibial plateau, reflecting osteoarthritis.
Impression:
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal in lateral meniscus.
2. Osteoarthritis of left knee ( more severe at medial compartment) with synovitis and small Baker's cyst
3. Anserine bursitis
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Bones:
See above.

Normal.

None

1.Large volume lipohemarthrosis.

3.Full-thickness chondral fissuring of the patellar apex with delamination of the medial facet.
4.Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the lateral patellar retinaculum.

Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Beginnende mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Intaktes MCL.

Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgedehnter Gelenkerguss mit verdickter Synovia und synvoialen Proliferationen. Gering Flüssigkeit in der Bursa infrapatellaris profunda.

U medijalnom kompartmentu femorotibijalnog zgloba uslijed osteoartritičnih promjena vidi se
stanjenje hrskavice, redukcija intraartikularnog prostora te rubnim osteofitom femoralnog
kondila i tibijalnog platoa s koštanim edemom te sa malom subhondralnom cistom tibijalnog
platoa i početnim formiranjem ciste femoralnog kondila.
Također uslijed deg. promjena osteofit medijalnog dijela medijalnog kondila femura koji prominira
u interkondilarnu fosu i utiskuje se u prednji križni ligament. Osteofiti kranijalnog i kaudalnog
pola posteriornog dijela patele, lateralnog platoa tibije, lateralnog femoralnog kondila i rubno
obje strane trohleje femura. Masivni ostoefit tibije u proksimalnom tibiofibularnom zglobu te
manji osteofiti glavice fibule.
Hiperintenzitet lateralnog interkondilarnog tuberkula tibije uslijed početnog formiranja
subhondralne ciste.
Intraosealne ciste lateralnog kondila femura uz hvatište kolateralnog ligamenta.
Kompleksna ruptura tijela medijalnog meniska uz degenerativne promjene stražnjeg roga.
Degenerativne promjene oba roga lateralnog meniska.
Uznapredovala mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta koji je horizontalnije položen i
stanjen u razni opisanog osteofita medijalnog femoralnog kondila, suspektna kompletna ruptura
u srednjoj trećini.
Pri hvatištu patelarne tetive za patelu u posteriornom dijelu vlakana hiperintenzitet koji može
odgovarati patelarnoj tendinopatiji.
Nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja lateralne strane trohleje femura.

Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala

Slight peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body without discrete medial meniscal tear. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon insertion, and iliotibial band are intact. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the fibular collateral ligament.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 11 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the patellar apex. Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the remainder of the patellar articular surface. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage. Tiny bone island medial femoral condyle.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the lateral collateral ligament.
2. Subtle patellofemoral chondrosis as described.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Suspected osteoarthritis/internal derangement right knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive appearance of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus consistent with complex tear, progressed since <[YEAR]>. Diminutive appearance of the medial meniscal body consistent with complex tear. There is peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. The anterior horn is intact.

Intrasubstance degeneration posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without discrete tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion.

Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament without tibial translation, new since previous study. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. The popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. The interval and is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No patellofemoral subluxation. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 10 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. Mild edema of the suprapatellar fat pad suggesting patellofemoral maltracking.

There is mild to moderate generalized patellofemoral chondrosis, progressed since previous study. There is extensive fissuring and thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage with small focal areas of full-thickness cartilage denuding, progressed since <[YEAR]>. Within the lateral formidable compartment, there is thinning of articular cartilage involving the central weightbearing aspect of the left femoral condyle and overlying the lateral tibial plateau, progressed since previous study.

Small knee joint effusion. Baker's cyst, measuring 30 x 19 x 65 mm.

Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

Progressive complex tearing of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus and progressive tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the medial femorotibial compartment, consistent with progressive moderate to severe medial compartment predominant tricompartment osteoarthritis of the right knee.
2. Since <[YEAR]>, interval development of low-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament without tibial translation.
3. 30 x 19 x 65 mm Baker's cyst.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain with walking up and down stairs.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion with lipomatous synovial hypertrophy in the suprapatellar recess. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Bucket-handle variant tear of the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus with a large displaced flap fragment into the intercondylar notch.
Medial compartment cartilage: High grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial weightbearing surfaces with deep cartilage fissuring cartilaginous flap formation.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and heterogeneity.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss along the medial patella with subchondral cystic change. High-grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal tendinosis without tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Bucket-handle variant tear of the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus with a large displaced flap fragment into the intercondylar notch.
2.	Tricompartmental chondrosis, worse in the patellofemoral and medial compartments.
3.	Moderate joint effusion with lipomatous synovial hypertrophy.
4.	Mild distal quadriceps and proximal patellar tendinosis without tearing.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Rule out meniscal tear.

PRIOR IMAGING: Plain film radiographs from [Date]
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable.

Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

T-TG distance is normal.

Lateral meniscus is intact. There is focal anterior and lateral femoral sulcus indentation with minor loss of cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle in the region of the sulcal depression. Overall articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

There is an oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus associated with a small posterior parameniscal cyst measuring about 4 to 5 mm in short axis tracking about 3 cm along the posterior margin of the meniscus and extending posterior to the base of the posterior cruciate ligament. Articular cartilage in the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is significant edema and soft tissue stranding extending from the space between the medial head of gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscle proximally into the popliteal fossa behind the distal femur and distally into the medial soft tissues of the calf deep to the pes anserine tendons. The finding is consistent with a ruptured Baker's cyst.

There is no significant knee effusion.

INTERPRETATION: 

Oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the medial meniscus involving body and posterior horn with associated para meniscal cyst posteriorly.

Nonacute osteochondral impaction injury involving lateral femoral sulcus with some mild focal cartilage loss overlying the region of cortical depression. No associated anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Soft tissue edema compatible with ruptured Baker's cyst.

original_report:
Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala medijalnog
kolateralnog ligamenta, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta
i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Simetrično održana širina oba kompartmenta TF zgloba. U području lateralnog kompartmenta
vidi se koštani edem platoa tibije i kondila femura, ddg kontuzijske promjene.
Medijalni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala bez znakova rupture.
Manja vertikalna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska koja se pruža do gornje pokrovne
plohe uz manji hiperintenzitet i izljev uz posteolateralni dio kapsule koji prema svemu odgovara
disrupciji meniskokapsularne sveze, ddg parcijalna ramp lezija.
Mucinozno promijenjen ACL koji je napet, bez znakova rupture.
Izmijenjen intenzitet signala polazišta tetive m popliteus uz manji peritendinozni izljev u sklopu
distenzije.
Zadebljan i izmijenjen intenzitet signala lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta u sklopu distenzije.
Veća količina izljeva u suprapatelarenom recesusu.
PD FS hiperintenzive lezije uz stražnji distalni dio femura 19x8mm i 7x5mm, dif. dg ganglion
ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

-3-Plane Loc, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Sag PD FS, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Screen Save

> Status post left knee arthroscope.
* Osteophytes of left knee with wearing of articular cartilage, more prominent at lateral compartment, reflecting osteoarthritis.
  Focal linear hypointensity material in anterior intercondylar notch (Srs/Img: [ID].
* Irregular contour and increased signal intensity of the intra-articular cartilage of patella lateral and inferior part, in favor of grade 2 chondromalacia.
> Mild interstitial increased signal of ACL on F/S T2WI, in favor of mild degeneration. 
  PCL and MCL and LCL appear to be within normal.
* Joint effusion with mild increased signal intensity on T1WI and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae ; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. 
  Fat stranding of infrapatellar fat pad, with a increase signal intensity inside on PD F/S image, connected to suprapatellar bursa.
* Small size of lateral meniscus with linear signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Subcutaneous edema over left knee, prominent in prepatella region.
  Focal heterogeneous hyperintense foci at anterior and lateral peripatellar subcutaneous fat on T2WI and PD image (Srs/Img: 11/8-10), in favor of post-operative change  (s/p left knee arthroscope for 8 years)
> Small superficial nodular-like foci in infrapatellar region (Srs/Img: [ID]; 7,8/7), nature unknown?R/O granuloma or scar formation
IMP:
1. C/W osteoarthritis of left knee, more severe at lateral compartment, with grade 3-4 chondral injury and loose body / detached cartilage.
2. Degeneration of lateral meniscus and R/O tear of posterior horn of lateral meniscus; differential diagnosis of  post-operative change ( partial menisectomy).
3. Synovitis- mild joint effusion of left knee with patellar plicae.
4. Grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL.   
5. R/O granuloma or scar formation over superficial skin.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further management

Obs. Rotura quiste de Backer versus desgarro gemelar.

Lesión ósea medular metafisaria distal del fémur que mide aproximadamente 18 x 12 mm en sus ejes
mayores, sin signos que sugieran agresividad local. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.

Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Úlcera condral de espesor total de la zona de carga posterior del cóndilo femoral lateral que mide
aproximadamente 5 x 12 mm en sus ejes mediolateral y anteroposterior respectivamente.
Condropatía superficial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los
cartílagos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
Leve a moderado derrame articular.
Pequeño quiste poplíteo. Esto se asocia a engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tendón del gastrocnemio
medial en su inserción proximal con rotura parcial en su unión miotendínea con fenómenos reparativos
parciales regionales. Impresiona extenderse en aproximadamente 23 mm en su eje cefalocaudal y

leve cantidad de liquido intermuscular hacia cefálico y caudal. El resto de la musculatura y tendones
regionales sin alteraciones.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.

Condropatía grado 3 de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral.

3. Anserine bursitis.
4. Degeneration of meniscus and R/O Ramp lesion over meniscocapsular junction of posteiror horn of medial meniscus.
5. In favor of mucoid degeneration of ACL.R/O grade 1 injury or degeneraiton of PCL and lateral patellar retinaculum.

femura, reducirana debljine zglobne hrskavice femura i patele, izraženije lateralno uz gubitak
širine zglobnog prostora te uz vidljivu fisuru u području medijalnog dijela platoa tibije, što
odgovara osteoartrotskim promjenama.
Također je vidljiva redukcija zglobne hrskavice pokrovnih ploha femoropatelarnog zgloba uz
suženje zglobnog prostora, što odovara osteoartrotskim promjenama.
U oba meniska vide se središnje zone blaže povišenog signala u T2 sekvenci što odgovara
degenerativnim promjenama meniska, bez znakova rupture. Također se vidi ekstruzija lateralnog
meniska koja se djelomično utiskuje u iliotibijalni trakt, uz zadebljanje hvatišta lateralnog
kolateralnog ligemetna u smislu entezopatskih promjena.
Prati se samo tanji snop vlakana prednjeg križnog ligamenta, dig.dg. može odgovarati stanju po
parcijalnoj rupturi ili degenerativnim promjenama.
Vidi se manja količina tekućine u posteriornom dijelu zglobnog prostora te manja količina u
suprapatelarnoj burzi te u infrapatelarnoj burzi uz hvatište patelarnog ligamenta na tuberositas
tibije.
Izmjenjen je intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive m. quadriceps femoris na kranijalni pol patele u
smislu tendinopatskih promjena, kao i intenzitet signala hvatišta patelarnog ligamenta u smislu

Findings:  Small knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  10 mm x 6 mm by 16mm well-defined lobulated intramedullary lesion in the distal metadiaphysis of the right femur display low signal on T1 and high signal on PD sequences. Multiple hypointense foci within the lesion representing calcification. No perilesional edema, endosteal scalloping or cortical destruction. Findings are in keeping with a low-grade chondroid lesion (enchondroma).  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact lateral meniscus. Radial tearing of the inner free of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.  Normal appearance of the distal biceps femoris tendon, popliteus tendon, pes anserine tendons and distal iliotibial band.  Intact quadriceps and patellar tendons. Severe patellofemoral degenerative changes with high-grade chondral thinning and full-thickness chondral loss along the lateral retropatellar facet and corresponding lateral femoral trochlea surface with underlying stress changes. The patella is lateralized relative to the femoral trochlear groove. Evidence of trochlear dysplasia with a shallow trochlear groove.  Relatively well-maintained medial and lateral tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage. Tricompartmental osteophyte formation noted.  
Conclusion:  Radial tearing of the inner free edge of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Severe patellofemoral degenerative changes with evidence of trochlear dysplasia and lateralization of the patella relative to the trochlear groove.

Ön çapraz bağdaki sinyal artışı parsiyel yırtığı telkin ediyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyale 4 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküsün arka kökünde parsiyel yırtık izleniyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal. Gastroknemyus-semimembranozis bursasındaki 7 cm uzunluklu ve en çok 8 mm kalınlıklı septalı sıvı lokülasyonu sızdırmıyor.

Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih
ligamenata, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa te incipijentno hvatišta patelarnog
ligametna.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran; parcijalna ruptura anteromedijalnih vlakana u
distalnoj trećini.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Kompleksna, predominantno horizontalna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska uz
ekstruziju diska. Manja "ramp" lezija uz nekoliko sitnih cisti posteriorne zglobne kapsule.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba uz hondromalaciju II.
stupnja i sitne osteofite medijalnog kompartmenta - početne OA promjene.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 2. Hondromalacija lateralne fasete patele II. stupnja.
Sitna Baker cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Myxoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus is also noted. Degenerate tearing of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is demonstrated.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning and fraying of the medial compartment articular cartilage. Mild - moderate thinning and fraying of the lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is also seen. No significant subchondral bony change. No cartilage loss. The patellofemoral articular cartilage is preserved.  
Conclusion: Medial and lateral compartment degenerate change with degenerate tearing of the medial and lateral menisci.

original_report:
MRI of Left Knee with 
-Locator, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS, SG PD FatSat




Finding:
Interstitial increased signal intensity of ACL and PCL on T2W FS.
Increased signal intensity at anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
Increased signal intensity at posterior horn of medial meniscus.
Mild knee joint effusion with subcutaneous infiltration at prepatellar to pretibial region and muscular edema over vastus lateralis, vastus intermedius, vastus medialis.
Bone marrow edema at medial femoral condyle and medial aspect of proximal tibia.
Fluid collection in the popliteal fossa between the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus tendons is noted.
The medial and lateral collateral ligaments, patellar tendon, popliteus tendon, biceps femoris tendon, and iliotibial tract appear unremarkable.  

Impression:
1) Suspect partial tear or mucoid degeneration of ACL and PCL.
2) Suspect tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
   Suspect tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3) Mild knee joint effusion with subcutaneous infiltration at prepatellar to pretibial region and muscular edema over vastus lateralis, vastus intermedius, vastus medialis.
4) Bone marrow edema at medial femoral condyle and medial aspect of proximal tibia.
-DDx: bone contusion, small osteonecrosis or bone marrow hyperemia.
5) Suspect Baker's cyst at left knee. 

Suggest clinical correlation and follow-up.

original_report: Subtotaler Ruptur der Quadrizepssehne rechts (einzig der laterale Anteil des Vastus lateralis erhalten). Retraktion der Quadricepssehne mit Einblutungen in der Rupturzone bis etwa 16 mm (4/7; 8/21). Kapsel und Bandapparat des rechten Kniegelenks intakt ohne Nachweis einer Signalalteration. Flächig höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz in der Belastungszone und horizontaler Einriss Pars intermedia und am Übergang zum Hinterhorn des mukoiden Innenmeniskus mit kleiner Ganglionzyste an der Vorderhornwurzel (1005/52; 4/19). Geringe mukoide Veränderungen auch des Außenmeniskus. Retropatellararthrose mit medialseitiger Betonung bei insbesonder flächiger, teils vollschichtiger Chondropathie mit subchondralen Ödemzonen an der medialen Kondylenwange (7/26). Plica mediopatellaris (8/13). Subkortikal gelegene T2-hyperintense Läsion mit enostalen Scalloping in der ventromedialen distalen Femurdiaphyse (5/18). Geringer Hämarthros, Baker-Zyste mit CC 4,5 cm. Periartikuläre Einblutungen.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

There is a flipped meniscal fragment in the medial meniscal tibial recess, measuring 12 x 3 x 6 mm. The medial meniscal posterior root and anterior horn are intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

Medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, and fibular collateral ligament are intact. There is strain/low-grade partial thickness tear of the popliteus muscle and proximal to the musculotendinous junction. The popliteus tendon at the lateral femoral condylar insertion shows mild tendinosis without tear. The biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 9 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage. Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. Trace knee joint fluid. Tiny Baker's cyst. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly dissecting oblique tear posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with flipped 12 x 3 x 6 mm meniscal fragment in the medial meniscal tibial recess and medial meniscal extrusion.
2. Strain/low-grade partial-thickness tear of the popliteus muscle as well as popliteus insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.

-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Ax DWI B800, Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (mm2/s), Screen Save



> Wearing of articular cartilage and spur formation and subchondral edema, more severe at medial compartment, and in favor of loose bodies, reflecting osteoarthritis.
> There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
> The contour of ACL & PCL MCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Slight interstitial increased singal of proximal LCL, R/O tendinosis
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. mild deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> A lobulated cystic lesion with internal septums in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst, about 2*2.5*6 cm in size ; mild perifocal edmea
> Mild fat stranding over infrapatellar fat pad.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee.
2. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. C/W Baker's cyst with perifocal edema.
4. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar plica.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

 Thinning articular cartilage along the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with focal subchondral bone edema observed.

  -  Mild MCL sprain
