MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Instability.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. There is patella alta with the Insall Salvati ratio measuring 1.38.

Patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

The TT-TG distance measures about 1 cm, within normal limits. Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint demonstrates mild chondral fraying inferiorly consistent with moderate chondrosis. Articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea is well-maintained.
There is edema within the infrapatellar fat pad laterally. This finding may be seen in extensor mechanism impingement.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is no evidence of a significant Baker's cyst. No evidence of a significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

Patella alta with moderate chondromalacia patella. There is also edema in Hoffa's fat inferior to the patella laterally compatible with the extensor mechanism impingement.

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Recent fall, suspected meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Complete radial tear posterior root medial meniscus with maceration of the posterior horn consistent with additional complex tearing, as well as peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. The anterior horn is intact.

Nondisplaced inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The posterior root, body, and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus are intact. No lateral meniscal extrusion.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits.

Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Patellar tendon is intact. Mild prepatellar/pedicle superficial soft tissue edema.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex and extending along the medial patellar facet. Small focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the lateral patellar facet. There is thinning of articular cartilage throughout the remainder of the patellar articular surface. There is fissuring of the lateral femorotibial articular cartilage. There is thinning and fissuring of medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Trace fluid in the semimembranosus tendon sheath. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complete radial tear posterior root of the medial meniscus with extensive complex tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with medial meniscal extrusion.
2. Nondisplaced inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion.
3. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear.
4. Moderate tricompartment chondrosis as detailed above, consistent with mild to moderate tricompartment osteoarthritis of the left knee, most pronounced involving the patellofemoral compartment.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 6 months of knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a predominant oblique radial tear at the posterior root with additional tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion into the meniscotibial gutter. Reactive edema along the medial joint line.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss along the periphery of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 4 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tear of the medial meniscus with a predominant oblique radial tear at the posterior root with additional tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion into the meniscotibial gutter. Reactive edema along the medial joint line.
2.	Medical compartment chondrosis.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss spanning the majority of the lateral patellar facet and at the lateral trochlea with osteophyte formation.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Findings of long-standing lateral patellofemoral maltracking with grade 4 patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, mild Hoffa's fat pad impingement, elongated lateral patellar facet and shallow trochlear groove, and elevated TT-TG distance of 21 mm.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial RIGHT knee pain for the past 2 months

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Mild amount of reactive marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle. Marginal osteophytes are noted at the distal femur, proximal tibia, and patella. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse chondral thinning along the anterior weightbearing and focal full thickness chondral loss at the margin of medial femoral condyle. The tibial plateau cartilage is normal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal. Small intraosseous ganglion at the tibial attachment of the posterior cruciate ligament.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Mild thickening of the medial collateral ligament with trace periligamentous edema consistent with degenerative MCL signal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Osteoarthritis with full thickness chondral loss involving the medial femoral condyle and subchondral reactive edema.

МР находка: Състояние след травма на менискус с давност от една година.  Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и структура. Тяхната сигнална характеристика е непроменена, няма МР данни за костномозъчен едем. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Наличие на минимален ставен излив. Запазена цялост на предна кръстна връзка. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна, със запазен континуитет и сигнална характеристика. Задният рог на медиалния менискус не се изобразява на топичното си място. Същият е фрагментиран, като единият фрагмент е експулсиран встрани, а другия е изместен медиално в ставата и се разполага над медиалната интеркондиларна еминенция. Налице е белега на Double PCA sign – патогномоничен за Bucket-handle лезия на латералния менисус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус и в двата си рога. Няма данни за травматични изменения на колатералните лигаменти. Медиалният колатерален лигамент е изместен от подлежащия менискален фрагмент. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Не се намират патологични промени в поплитеалната ямка и фоса интеркондиларис. Липсва посттравматичен едем на меките тъкани. 
Заключение: Описаната лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус е по типа на Bucket-handle. Минимален ставен излив.

Analiza TT-TG udaljenosti otežana zbog nemogućnosti širenja polja snimanja aksijalnih sekvenci
kaudalno, te koliko je dostupno iznosi oko 16 mm što ukazuje na graničnu patelofemoralnu
instabilnost.
Kut lateralne trohlearne inklinacije iznosi oko 7° što upućuje na displaziju trohleje.
Wiberg 3 tip patele te lateralna subluksacija patele.
Insall-Salvati omjer iznosi 1,67 što odgovara visoko položenoj pateli.
U femoropatelarnom zglobu vidi se lateralni osteofit trohleje koji je dio zglobnog tijela,
denudacija hrskavice i subhondralni koštani edem lateralne fasete patele i lateralnog dijela
trohleje. Unutar istog zgloba vidi se osteofit veličine 9 mm (CC) koji polazi sa centralnog dijela
proksimalne polovice trohleje femura. Osteofiti posteriornog dijela superiornog i kaudalnog pola
patele.
Također izražene gonartrotske promjene femorotibijalnog zgloba u vidu stanjenja hrskavice,
gubitka zglobnog prostora i lateralnih osteofita femura i tibije.
Mala subhondralna cista tibije uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Između iliotibijalnog trakta i kranijalnog dijela lateralnog kondila femura vidi se hondralno
slobodno tijelo veličine 13x5x16 mm (apxllxcc) uz manji okolni izljev.
Blagi hiperintenziteti stražnjih rogova oba meniska kao i prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska uslijed
degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova rupture.
Nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala kolateralnih ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg
križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.

MRI of right knee without contrast.

The lateral meniscus shows no obvious tear.

4. The medial & lateral collateral ligaments, quadriceps & patellar tendons show intact appearance.
5. No obvious bone marrow edema or periarticular soft tissue edema, probably as a result of chronic injury.
6. Intact patellar cartilage.

(1) (Chronic ) complete ACL tear.
(2) Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
(3) Moderate knee joint effusion. 
Synovial thickening with multiple projections. PVNS cannot be ruled out. 
Suggest arthrographic correlation.

Meniscopatía interna.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.

menisco tibial a nivel del cuerpo con edema las partes blandas adyacentes. También se observa edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial con imagen de pequeña fractura subcortical.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y de carga del cóndilo femoral medial con
cambios óseos secundarios.
Resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Condropatía superficial de la
faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Cambios entesopáticos
cuadricipitales distales.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.

Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa al receso menisco tibial a nivel del cuerpo
con edema de las partes blandas.
Edema óseo periférico del platillo tibial con imagen sugerente pequeña fractura subcortical, probablemente
de manera reactiva.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la región central y de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía superficial de la faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal. Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion.

Medial meniscus: Mild myxoid degeneration without tear.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Discoid lateral meniscus with extensive complex tearing at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral and mild lateral tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Small knee joint effusion.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is a moderate, focal bone contusion/subchondral bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau at the medial joint line at the site of the medial meniscus tear. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex, predominantly radial tear involving the inner margin of the body of the medial meniscus near the anterior horn/body junction (se 2, img 20 and se 5, img 11) with a superiorly flipped thin fragment extending into the anteromedial meniscofemoral recess (se 5, img 12 to 16 and se 4, img 7). Underlying reactive bone marrow edema at the medial femoral condyle and to a lesser degree at the medial tibial plateau. The tear of the meniscal body slightly extends into the posterior horn. No significant meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There are small 3 mm areas of focal full thickness cartilage fissuring (grade 4 chondral fissuring) at the medial patellar facet and at the groove of the femoral trochlea. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 3 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

1.	Complex, predominantly radial tear involving the inner margin of the body of the medial meniscus with a superiorly flipped meniscal fragment extending into the meniscofemoral recess.

Moderate chondromalacia of the medial patella facet.

Complex oblique undersurface tear of the medial meniscus posterior horn.

Medial collateral ligament and supporting knee ligamentous structures are intact.

hrskavice medijalne i lateralne trohleje femura kao i sulkusa femura (hondromalacija 3. stupnja).
Hondromalacija I./II. stupnja lateralne fasete patele.
Vidljive su incipijentne koštane apozicije patele i femura u femoropatelarnom zglobu.

Rubne koštane apozicije medijalnog i lateralnog platoa tibije i kondila femura.
Manji izljev u koljenu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste. Zadebljana je medijalna plica u
suprapatelarnom recessusu.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild left knee joint effusion. Tiny uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Note some thinning and irregularity involving the cartilage of the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle as is identified on the previous MRI. No subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.

The medial meniscus and medial collateral ligament are unremarkable.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Redemonstration of tearing of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion of the attenuated body of the meniscus. Appearances are again compatible with an unstable meniscal tear.

There is some marked thinning and irregularity of the articular cartilage involving the weightbearing surfaces of the lateral femoral and tibial condyles with associated mild focal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes and some marginal osteophyte.

The fibular collateral ligament complex appears intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Redemonstration of marked the fissuring involving both the medial and lateral patellar facet, not significantly changed since the previous MRI, with some very minimal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity change.

Morphology of the trochlear articular cartilage is unremarkable.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Suspected multiple small osteochondral bodies projected within the posterior joint space medial to the posterior cruciate ligament.

CONCLUSION:
1.Redemonstration of an unstable tear involving the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, as described.
2.Tricompartmental articular cartilage thinning and fissuring most prominently affecting the patellofemoral and lateral femorotibial compartments.
3.Some associated small multiple osteochondral bodies within the posterior joint space surrounded by synovial fluid.
4.Mild left knee joint effusion.

There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

2. Diffuse degenerative tearing with maceration and extrusion of the medial meniscus.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without evidence of acute ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis with a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

Trouvailles: 
Il y a une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse plus proéminent impliquant le fémur distalement. Il n'y a pas de composante tissulaire extra-osseuse. Il y a changements similaires mais moins marqués impliquant le tibia et le péroné proximalement. 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. Il y a un kyste ganglionnaire multi-loculé de 2cm AP x 1.8cm transverse x 1cm cranio-caudal au niveau de la région intercondylienne antérieure. Aucune évidence de déchirure méniscale associée. Le kyste semble être en provenance des fibres distales du ligament croisé antérieur. 
Il y a proéminence et fragmentation de la tubérosité tibiale sans oedème osseux compatible avec une ancienne maladie de Osgood-Schlatter. 
Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité. 
Conclusion: 
1. Il n'y a aucune déchirure méniscale ou blessure du croisé antérieur. 
2. Kyste ganglionnaire au niveau de la région inter-condylienne antérieure qui semble être en provenance du croisé antérieur. Ceci pourrait causer des douleurs surtout en extension complète du genou. À corréler cliniquement. 
3. Séquelles d'ancienne maladie d'Osgood-Schlatter. 
4. Découverte fortuite d'une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse. Ceci est non-spécifique et pourrait représenter une reconversion en moelle rouge. Un processus infiltratif est moins probable mais demeure dans le diagnostic différentiel. Une investigation hématologique est recommandée.

MRI LEFT KNEE  (plain)

Clinical information:
Left knee pain and stiffness. Ultrasound shows a large complex collection at the posterior joint, MRI suggested. 

Technique: 
Multiplanar MR of the knee according to protocol.

Comparison: 
Ultrasound report dated [Date]

Findings: 

Menisci

Lateral meniscus: intact

Medial meniscus: Several tears of the medial meniscus noted. Radial tear close to the posterior root of the medial meniscus and another inferior surfacing horizontal tear is seen at the posterior horn. Radial tear with truncation also seen at the body of meniscus, which is attenuated in size. Most of the medial meniscus is extruded from the jointline, approximately 0.4cm medial to joint line. 

Ligaments

Anterior cruciate ligament: intact

Posterior cruciate ligament: intact 

Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact. Thickening of the superificial component of the medial collateral ligament with moderate periligamentous edema is suggestive of moderate sprain. 

Lateral collateral ligament: The iliotibial band, biceps femoris tendon, fibular collateral ligament and popliteus muscle and tendon intact. 

Posterolateral corner structures: Intact

Extensor Mechanism

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

Fluid

Moderate knee effusion noted with evidence of synovitis. Thinned wall Baker's cyst with thin septations measuring 4.1cm x 3.4cm x 6.1cm (TSxAPxCC) is seen, consistent with a complex Bakers cyst. No fluid fluid level is seen..Small amount of fluid at the posterior knee is probably secondary to previous rupture.

Mild prepatellar bursitis observed. 

Osseous and Articular Structures

Bones: Mild oedema is seen at the anterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau. Moderate degenerative changes with osteophytosis of all three compartments noted. No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.

Patellofemoral compartment: Full thickness chondral loss and fissures most observable at the patella apex and medial patella facet, associated with subchondral oedema. 

Medial compartment: Minimal chondrosis. 

Lateral compartment: Minimal chondrosis. 

Others:

Hoffas fat pad: clear

Muscles: Severe atrophy and fatty infiltration of the semimembranosus muscle. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT

1.	Multiloculated Bakers cyst with prior rupture. No evidence of haemorrhage or active inflammatory changes. 
2.	Several tears of the medial meniscus, including a radial tear of the posterior root, horizontal tear of the posterior horn and truncation of the inner free edge of the body of medial meniscus. Medial meniscal extrusion noted. 
3.	Moderate sprain of the superficial component of the medial collateral ligament. It is intact with no tear. 
4.	Severe patellofemoral chondral loss and fissures with subchondral oedema. Otherwise only minimal chondrosis at the tibiofemoral joint. Osteophytes in all three compartments.
5.	Mild prepatellar bursitis.

Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del resto de los compartimentos femorotibiales.

Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.

Rotura compleja del menisco medial con leve extrusión y segmento parcialmente desplazado.

Leve a moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Minimal focal increased T2 signal peripheral lateral femoral condyle may reflect resolving low grade osseous contusion. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Heterogeneity at the median ridge compatible with low grade cartilage loss. No focal high grade cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with superimposed edema of the retroquadriceps fat and low-grade interstitial tearing of the posterior lateral insertional fibers. Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Moderate distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with low-grade partial-thickness tear of the posterior lateral insertional fibers.
2.	Minimal bone marrow edema peripheral lateral femoral condyle, may reflect resolving low grade osseous contusion. 
3.	Mild patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Diminutive horn of the lateral meniscus consistent with complex tear. The lateral meniscal body and posterior horn show intrasubstance degeneration without additional tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion. The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration and slight peripheral extrusion of the body, without tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament. Small insertional cysts at the anterior cruciate ligament foot plate.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear. Slight lateral patellar subluxation. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Foci of full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex, lateral patellar facet, as well as central to lateral femoral trochlea. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the lateral femorotibial compartment. There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain and swelling
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. 5 mm intra-articular body posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Small intraosseous ganglion in the tibia at the posterior meniscal root insertion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis. Small marginal osteophytes in the medial joint compartment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis. Small marginal osteophytes in the lateral joint compartment.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Severe loss of cartilage along the lateral patellar facet and lateral femoral trochlea with marginal osteophyte formation and small foci of subchondral marrow edema. There is full thickness cartilage fissuring in the central femoral trochlea and a small full thickness cartilage defect along the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Tricompartmental knee osteoarthritis, greatest in the patellofemoral joint compartment.
2. Small knee joint effusion.
3. No meniscal tear.

MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    ? Anterior cruciate ligament   .

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. Patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained. The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

There is a complex bucket-handle tear of medial meniscus. Fragments are seen. Into the intercondylar notch there is associated chondral fraying seen to the weightbearing cartilage of the medial femoral condyle as well as the tibial cartilage to a lesser degree.

There is a linear tear seen in the posterior horn and posterior body of lateral meniscus extending to the inferior articular surface with some apical truncation. There is a disruption of the lateral meniscal tibial ligament with superior displacement of the meniscal body away from the tibial plateau. No other meniscal tear is seen to the lateral meniscus. There is severe chondral thinning and fissuring and fraying seen to the weightbearing cartilage of lateral femoral condyle and to a lesser degree lateral tibial plateau.

There are no normal intact anterior cruciate ligament fibers demonstrated. There is heterogeneous thickened mixed T2 signal seen along the course of the anterior cruciate ligament. Findings are in keeping with a high-grade to complete anterior cruciate ligament tear. There is an associated anterior cruciate ligament ganglion cyst. Anterior tibial drawer measured in the lateral joint compartment is between 5 and 6 mm is borderline.

The posterior cruciate ligament is intact and appears unremarkable.

The medial collateral ligament is intact and appears unremarkable.

The lateral collateral ligament complex including the fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon, popliteus tendon and IT band all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small Baker's cyst demonstrated.

There is a moderate knee effusion with mild reactive synovitis.

INTERPRETATION: 

Bucket-handle tear of medial meniscus with moderate chondrosis to the medial joint compartment.

Complex tear of lateral meniscus involving body and posterior horn associated with what appears to be disruption of the meniscotibial attachment laterally. Severe chondrosis is seen to the lateral joint compartment.

High-grade to complete subacute to nonacute tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with anterior cruciate ligament ganglion cyst. Borderline anterior tibial drawer.

Moderate Baker's cyst.

Large knee effusion with synovitis.

- Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Loss of ACL signal intensity, loss morphology and discontinuity; chronic complete tear without avulsion is suggested. 
- Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Buckling PCL without abnormal SI.

Medial compartment 
- Medial meniscus: Myxoid changed. 
- Medial collateral ligament: Slightly high signal within deep part; mild sprain is suggested. 
- Medial tibial plateau: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture 
- Medial femoral condyle: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 

Lateral compartment 
- Lateral meniscus: multiple chronic tear lesion as describe below 
-- Longitudinal tear from anterior horn down to anterior root 
-- Oblique vertical tear from posterior root down to peripheral surface but preserve insertion of posterior root. 
-- Radical tear at posterior horn. 

- Iliotibial band: Intact. 
- Lateral collateral ligament: Intact. 
- Popliteus tendon: High SI without disruption; mild sprain at proximal part is suggested. 
- Popliteofibular ligament: Intact. 
- Biceps femoris tendon : Intact. 
- Lateral tibial plateau: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 
- Lateral femoral condyle: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 

Patellofemoral compartment 
- Quadriceps tendon: Intact. 
- Patellar tendon: intact. 
- Medial patellar retinaculum: Intact. 
- Lateral patellar retinaculum: Intact. 
- Mild subcutaneous edema around patella 

Others 
- Muscle: Unremarkable. 
- Bursa: Unremarkable 
- Bone: 
-- Adjacent to ACL tear, there is faint bone bruise at lateral condyle and posterior proximal aspect of tibial plateua. 
-- - Secondary bony degeneration at lateral part of tibial and femur by evidence of osteophyte and subchrodosclerosis. 
- Neurovascular bundles: Intact. 
- Effusion within patellofemoral joints up to suprapatella bursa. 

IMPRESSIONL: 
- Chronic complete tear of ACL. 
- Multiple chronic lateral meniscus tear at anterior horn, posterior horn and posterior part, however posterior root is preserved. 
- Mild sprain of proximal part of popliteal ligament. 
- Mild sprain of medial collateral ligament. 
- Secondary bony degeneration. 
- Residual faint bone bruise at lateral condyle and posterior proximal aspect of tibial plateua 
- Effusion within patellofemoral joints up to suprapatella bursa.

Preserved cartilage. Extensor mechanism is intact. No Hoffa's fat pad edema. Intact retinacula.

Mild chondrosis. Preserved cartilage. No discrete meniscal tear. Lateral collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendons, and popliteus tendons are intact. Iliotibial band is unremarkable.

Signs of mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with insertional bony cystic changes at the tibial eminence. Posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild medial compartment chondrosis with medial meniscus extrusion associated with a small radial posterior root tear and heterogeneous signal extending into the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no free fragment.
2. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Виждат се малки остеофити по ставните краища на феумра и тибията. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенции. Хрущялът на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. МР данни за лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е с повишен интензитет на сигнала. В него се вижда хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и до хрущяла на тибията. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти - без особености. Сухожилие на m.quadriceps femoris - нормално изобразяване. МР данни за инсерционит на пателарния лигамент. В лигамента на залавното му към пателата място се изобразява зона на повишен интензитат на сигнала. Едемни промени в меките тъкани около инсерцията на лигамента.  Наличие на Бекерова киста с типична локализация и големина 53/25 мм. Заключение: МР данни за дегенеративна промяна и скъсване в задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. Инсерционит на лигамента на пателата. Бекерова киста. Малък ставен излив.

degenerativnih promjena, uz moguću parcijalnu vertikalnu rupturu donje plohe trupa.
Distenzija MCL. LCL održan uz entezopatske promjene hvatišta za femur.
Degenerativne promjene ACL blažeg stupnja, uz održan kontinuitet. PCL primjerenog prikaza.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 1, uz reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarnog zgloba i hondromalaciju II. stupnja. Osteofiti kranijalnog i kaudalnog pola
patele.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.

Masna atrofija prikazane natkoljenične muskulature GC 2.
Izljev u koljenu. Bakerova cista, aksijalno dimenzija 23 x 9 mm.
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i infrapatelarno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala

> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
  Frond-like depositions of fatty tissue in the suprapatellar bursa, R/O lipoma arborescens (diffuse synovial lipoma)
> PCL and medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Subcutaneous edmea over right knee.
> Some varicose veins.

1. Osteoarthritis of right knee, more prominent at medial compartment with grade 4 chondromalacia.

3. Baker's cyst with perifocal edmea.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Fluid:
Mild to moderate joint effusion with a small popliteal cyst measuring 1.3 x 1.0 x 4.3 mm. There are no signs of leakage.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
The medial meniscus and the cartilage surfaces are unremarkable.
Mild edema of the meniscocapsular junction without fluid cleft.
High grade, almost complete tear of the superficial and anterior deep fibers of the femoral insertion of the medial collateral ligament with faint possible remaining attachment of the posterior deep fibers and the distal insertion.
There is periligamentous and pericapsular edema.
Medial suprapatellar plica as a variant.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
The lateral meniscus and the lateral cartilage surfaces are unremarkable.
High-grade partial tear of the mid fibers of the lateral collateral ligament without retraction or complete discontinuity, although distal fibers are not clearly seen.
The remaining components of the lateral collateral complex are preserved.
Mild tendinopathy of the popliteus tendon and edema of the myotendinous junction a small synovial cyst.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Complete discontinuity of the proximal fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament with reactive synovitis of the intercondylar notch. Mild associated anterior tibial translation.
The posterior cruciate ligament has a buckled appearance without tear.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
The extensor mechanism is unremarkable.
The patellofemoral cartilage is preserved.
Superficial soft tissue swelling a laminar fluid collection.

Bones:
Posterior lateral bone contusion without fracture line..

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Subcutaneous soft tissue swelling and myotendinous junction tear of the fibers of the distal vastus lateralis.
Neurovascular bundles are unremarkable.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Full-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament
2.High-grade / almost complete tear of the superficial and deep components of the medial collateral ligament as detailed above.
3.High grade tear of the lateral collateral ligament.
4.Joint effusion and popliteal cyst.

For further findings, please see the body of the report.

Interprétation :

Minime épanchement intra-articulaire qui pourrait être de nature physiologique. Large kyste de Baker qui a progressé de façon significative dans l’intervalle, mesurant 2.8 x 2.6 x 7.1 cm, avec extension significative inférieurement le long du muscle gastrocnémien interne avec multiples loculations liquidiennes et œdème, suggérant une rupture partielle associée. 

Dans l’intervalle, il y a une déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne avec macération/composante radiaire à la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal de même qu’une composante potentiellement longitudinale horizontale s’étendant de la jonction de la corne postérieure avec le corps méniscal jusqu’à la corne antérieure et la surface articulaire supérieure. Extrusion méniscale significative avec possiblement un petit flap méniscal déplacé au sein de la gouttière supérieure à l’interligne articulaire fémoro-tibiale interne, en contact avec la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale du ligament collatéral interne. Légère œdème au pourtour du ligament collatéral interne réactionnel ou en lien avec une entorse de grade 1.

Il y a une progression de changements dégénératifs/chondropathie au compartiment fémoro-tibial, maintenant modérée à sévère, avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes aux  surfaces portante et non-portante (versant postérieur du condyle fémoral interne). Minime/début de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels au versant interne de la surface portante. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 

Le ménisque externe est grossièrement inchangé sans déchirure significative. Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. Légers changements dégénératifs/chondropathie au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation diffuse des surfaces articulaires.

Légère atténuation du ligament croisé antérieur avec légère anomalie de signal sans déchirure significative. Ceci pourrait être en lien avec une ancienne entorse de bas grade. Pas de déchirure transfixiante. Le ligament croisé postérieur est intact sans déchirure. Petits kystes ganglionnaires intra-osseux sous son insertion distale au versant postérieur du tibia, augmentés dans l’intervalle.

La rotule est hautement située. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure. À nouveau, changements dégénératifs/chondropathie sévère au versant interne du compartiment patellofémoral, légèrement plus marqué qu’à l’étude précédente, avec atténuation transfixiante des surfaces cartilagineuses et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Conclusion :

Dans l’intervalle, déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne tel que détaillé ci-haut.

Progression de changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentale, modérée à sévère au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et sévère au versant interne du compartiment patellofémoral tel détaillé ci-haut.

Progression d'un kyste de Baker (large) avec signes de rupture partielle.

Autres trouvailles tel que décrit ci-haut.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Moderate tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing of the proximal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis with low-grade interstitial tearing.
2.	Lateral patellofemoral maltracking.

Diz çevresindeki kaslarda sarkopeni ile uyumlu hacim kaybı gözleniyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

U distalnoj dijametafizi femura vidi se se oštro ograničena, polimikrolobulirana, intramedularna,
centralno smještena lezija s heterogenim hondroidnim matriksom dimenzija 23x23x45 mm
(APxLLxCC). Ne nalazi se signifikantne nazubljenosti endoosta te će tvorba radiomorfološki
prvenstveno odgovarati enhondromu. Ranije snimke i snimke drugih modaliteta nisu dostupne za
komparaciju.
Uz patelarnu inserciju lateralnog patelofemoralnog ligamenta nalazi se cista dimenzija aksijalno
8x4 mm (APxLL), dif.dg. može odgovarati posttraumatskoj ganglion cisti.
Intraosealna ganglion cista na tibijalnom hvatištu stražnjeg križnog ligamenta duljeg promjera 10
mm.
Stanjene hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba u sklopu OA promjena.
Blaže degenerativne promjene prednjeg križnog ligamenta. Primjeren prikaz stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta.
Blaže do umjerene deg. promjene stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska.
Lateralni i medijalni menisk bez znakova rupture.
Primjeren je prikaz kolateralni ligamenata.
Bakerova cista promjera 8 mm.
Manja količina izljeva u području suprapatelarnog recesusa. Inkomplentna suprapatelarna plika.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

МР находка: Костите формиращи дясната колянна ства се изобразяват с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Хрущяла покриващ ставните повърхности и пателата е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Лезия на заден рог на медиален мениск, като лезията достига артикуларната повърност. Хомогенно анинтенсен преден медиален преден рог. Начални дегенеративни промени по латералния мениск. Двата кръстни лигамента се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сингален интензитет. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Хиперинтенсна в PD секвенцията, мултилокулирана находка проследима около медиалното сухожилие на гастрокнемиуса с приблизителни размери 12мм/26мм/36мм- Бейкърова киста. Не се откриха МР данни за ставен излив.
Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет.
Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 1,1. Заключение: МР данни за лезия на заден рог на медиален мениск, достигаща ставната повърхност- grade 3. Начални дегенеративни промени по латерален мениск. Бейкърова киста с описаната локализация.

COMPARISON:Plain films [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Twisting injury 4 weeks prior. Suspected transient lateral patellar dislocation.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact. Popliteus tendon insertion is intact.

No femoral trochlear dysplasia. No patellofemoral subluxation. The TT-TG distance measures 20 mm, above the upper limit of normal. The patellar retinacula are intact. Once again seen are well-corticated osseous fragments at the tibial tuberosity in keeping with chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease. Minimal marrow edema and tiny cysts are noted in the fragments. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Lateralization of the tibial tubercle, predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking/instability. No patellofemoral subluxation.
2. High-grade patellofemoral chondrosis suggesting evolving moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. Chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease, also shown previously.
4. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT W WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain; severe knee pain and decreased range of motion; history of negative cultures; symptoms for one week with difficulty walking and bearing weight
Comparison: Radiograph of the right knee dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 3.0 system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), without and with intravenous contrast.

Contrast: 4 mL of Gadavist

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Multiple areas of curvilinear serpiginous high T2 and low T1 signal intensity are noted in the distal femoral metadiaphysis as well as in the medial femoral condyle and proximal medial tibia with central areas of fat, characteristic for osteonecrosis. The largest in the femur measures up to 4.8 cm mediolateral by 2.5 cm anterior posterior by 7.1 cm craniocaudal dimension, with a thick peripheral rim of enhancement and central areas of fat signal intensity. These findings are age-indeterminate with a probable chronic component given the central fat and absence of surrounding geographic marrow edema. Very subtle periarticular edema is noted along the anteromedial aspect anterolateral aspect of the femoral condyles. There is mild nonspecific marrow edema and a patella. Mild marrow edema is noted at the anterior patella and deep to the popliteus tendon. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Minimal joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild grade 1/2 chondrosis of the lateral patellar facet and medial patellar facet. Thickened plica at the medial margin of the patellofemoral joint.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinopathy with a low-grade intrasubstance delaminating tear centrally.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minimal lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. No significant joint effusion or erosive changes to suggest septic arthritis or inflammatory arthropathy. 

2. Multiple moderate to large areas of signal abnormality in the distal femur and proximal tibia demonstrating characteristic serpiginous high T2 and low T1 signal intensity, characteristic for areas of osteonecrosis. There is likely chronic component given the areas of central fat, without surrounding geographic marrow edema.

3. Mild nonspecific marrow edema in the anterior patella. Subtle periarticular marrow edema along the anteromedial and anterolateral aspects of the femoral condyles. Mild marrow edema and enhancement deep to the popliteus tendon. These findings may represent stress-related changes or early developing areas of osteonecrosis.

4. Mild patellofemoral osteoarthritis.

 Signed On: [DATE]

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Knee pain. Exam consistent with? Meniscal injury 3. Ultrasound shows? Lateral meniscal tear. Please note this scan was ordered for the left knee but the patient insisted that the right knee was symptomatic and at the patient's insistence the right knee was scanned, not the left.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

There is increased T2 signal and mild thickening of the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon consistent with mild patellar tendinosis.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact.

Articular cartilage of the patella demonstrates chondral fraying and signal change to the lateral facet with some fissuring and very faint subcortical edema seen within the bone of the lateral facet of patella. There is associated trochlear cartilage fraying and fissuring seen involving the trochlear apex and medial facet. Findings are consistent with severe chondrosis of the patellofemoral joint.

The TT-TG distance measures about 9 mm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus appears intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The medial meniscus is intact. There is some linear nonsurfacing signal seen in the posterior horn extending into the posterior body of medial meniscus but a definite surfacing meniscal tear is not identified.

There is moderate chondrosis of the medial joint compartment with some regions of focal fraying and thinning and one focus of mild subcortical edema seen to the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex appear intact.

There is a small to moderate sized Baker's cyst present.

There is no evidence of a significant knee effusion.

Marrow signal is otherwise normal. 

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild patellar tendinosis.

Severe chondrosis involving patellofemoral joint.

Moderate medial compartment chondrosis.

Baker's cyst.

No evidence of internal derangement or lateral meniscal tear.

Amincissement du cartilage diffus léger à modéré tricompartimental plus prononcé au compartiment interne où il y a aussi un foyer de 1cm de perte de cartilage de pleine épaisseur à l’aspect postérieur du condyle fémoral interne.

Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, ruptured Baker's cyst with fluid extending along the superficial surface of the medial collateral ligament.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.

Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 9 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Severe medial compartment chondrosis.

Ganglion cista promjera oko 7 mm na hvatištu LCL za femur u sklopu kronične entezopatije ili

Lokulirani izljev uz iliotibijalni trakt moguće u sklopu sindroma iliotibijalnog trakta.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa uz vidljiv veći entezofit kranijalng pola
patele.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska na degenerativnoj podlozi. Ekstruzija
trupa lateralnog meniska. Uznapredovale degenerativne promjene i gotovo poptpuna destrukcija
prednjeg roga lateralnog meniska.
Horizontalno intrasupstancijsko povišenje intenziteta signala medijalnog meniska, na
degenerativnoj bazi, bez jasnih znakova rupture.
Lobulirane ganglion ciste uz stražnji korijen oba meniska.
Patela je medioponirana, Wiberg 1.
Blago je reducirana debljina femoropatelranog zgloba uz vidljivu fisuru lateralne trohleje femura
(hondromalacija III. stupnja).
Gotovo je potpuno reducirana debljina artikulacijske hrskavice lateralnog kompartmenta
femorotibijalnog zgloba uz vidljiv opsežan subhondralni edem lateralnog platoa tibije koji je
deniveliran u sklopu OA promjena (hondromalacija IV. stupnja). OA promjene FP zgloba.
Hondromalacija III. stupnja zglobne plohe medijalnog kondila femura.
Lamelarno tekućine infrapatelarno. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Tendinopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. popliteusa.
Nešto tekućine oko tetive medijalne glave m. gastrocnemiusa.
Ganglion cista promjera 10 mm uz anteriorni rub medijalne glave m. gastrocnemiusa.
Masna degeneracija muskulature GC2 u sklopu atrofičkih promjena.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет, с изключение на пателата, по горния ръб на която се виждат остеофитни наслагвания. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна е изтънен. В задния рог на медиалния менискус се изобразява хиперинтензна лезия, съответстваща на дегенеративна промяна. Тя е с линеарен кос ход, достигаща до ставния хрущял на тибията. В латералния менискус също се вижда патологична лезия. Тя се представя като плътна висосигнална линеарна лезия с хоризонтален ход в средния дял на латералния менискус, между двата му рога. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Хрущял на пателата – б.о. Фоса поплитеа – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми – със запазена цялост. Заключение: МР данни за левостранна гонартроза. Дегенеративни промени в двата менискуса със скъсване на латералния менискус. Минимален ставен излив.

INDICATION: Assess block knee and context of known medial meniscus injury.

COMPARISON: Compare with right knee radiographs from [Date].

FINDINGS:

Moderate right knee effusion. No Baker's cyst.

ANTERIOR COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. Extensor mechanism is intact. Minimal soft tissue infiltration surrounding the anterior aspect of the knee. Prominent medial plica without definite insinuation into the patellofemoral compartment.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. Bucket-handle tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of medial meniscus with a flipped fragment in the intercondylar notch. The flipped fragment measures around 2.1 x 0.5 x 0.6 cm. Medial collateral ligament partially covered on the field of view appears intact. Partially covered pes anserine tendons are also intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. No discrete meniscal tear. Lateral collateral ligament, popliteus tendons, and biceps femoris tendons are intact. Iliotibial band unremarkable.

INTERCONDYLAR COMPARTMENT:
Anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament are intact.

Portions visualized of muscle bulk and may neurovascular structures are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. Bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus with displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. No significant chondrosis. No other meniscal fragment visualized.
2. Moderate knee joint effusion
3. Lateral meniscus is intact.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Month and a half of knee pain associated with running.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Minimal distal quadriceps tendinosis with some edema in the adjacent suprapatellar fat. No tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Minimal distal quadriceps tendinosis.
2.	No acute osseous, meniscal or ligamentous injury. No significant chondrosis.

original_report: МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. МР данни за фрактура на главата на фибулата. В главата на фибулата се изобразява хипоинтензна фрактурна линия с неправилен ход, която достига до артикулиращата повърхност на костта. Няма данни за значима дислокация на костни фрагменти. Налице е обширен костно-мозъчен едем в главата на фибулата. Виждат се едемни промени в околните мускулните групи и в мастната тъкан. Малко количество течност се изобразва дорзомедиално спрямо главата на фибулата, между m. popliteus и m. soleus. Костите, формиращи колянната става, са със нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е запазен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Нормално изобразяване на двата менискуса. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – нормално представени. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на m. quadriceps femoris – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за фрактура на главата на фибулата без данни за дислокация на костните фрагменти.

Interprétation : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité. 
En corrélation avec les radiographies du genou droit, suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7-8mm de diamètre avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal de façon associée. Ceci est nouveau dans l’intervalle. Stabilité d’une déchirure longitudinale horizontale centrée au corps du ménisque interne s’étendant légèrement aux cornes postérieures et antérieures et à la surface articulaire inférieure. 
Également dans l’intervalle, il y a progression significative des changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec perte transfixiante des surfaces chondrales, principalement aux surfaces portantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 
Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 
Légers changements de signal au sein de la corne antérieure du ménisque externe suggérant des changements de nature mucoïde dégénératifs. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation/fissure chondrale partielle à la surface portante et petits ostéophytes marginaux associés. 
Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. 
Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste intra-osseux réactionnel sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur. 
L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral, plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe et apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ceci a minimalement progressé dans l’intervalle. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 
Légère tendinose à l’insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et de façon plus diffuse au niveau du tendon patellaire. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Conclusion : 
Nouvelle déchirure radiale transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion secondaire marquée du corps méniscal tel que détaillé ci-haut. Suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne, en corrélation avec une radiographie du genou droit. 
Progression dans l’intervalle des changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux, sévères au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe de l’apex patellaire. 
Petit épanchement intra-articulaire.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala medijalnog
kolateralnog ligamenta, stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa i patelarnog
ligamenta.
Kompletna ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta u području hvatišta za femur. Dio vlakana
položen je interkondilarno posteriorno uz medijalni kondil femura, može ograničavati kretnje u
zglobu.
Lateralni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga i dijela tijela medijalnog meniska uz kuglasto oblikovan flap
meniska interkondilarno posteriorno uz PCL, promjera oko 9 mm, može ograničavati kretnje u
zglobu.
Patela je lateroponirana, Wiberg 3. Kut lateralne trohlearne inklinacije iznosi 16°.
Primjerena je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femoropatelarnog zgloba. Manja fisura hrskavice
medijalne fasete patele uz subhondralni edem - hondromalacija 4. stupnja.
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba, izrežnije medijalnog
kompartmenta uz promjene tipa hondromalacije 2. stupnja, a u posteriornom dijelu medijalnog
kondila vidljiv manji defekt artikulacijske hrskavice duljine do 2 mm uz subhondralni edem -
hondromalacija 4. stupnja.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta, bez znakova
rupture.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. quadriceps za patelu.
Veći izljev u koljenu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Il y a un petit épanchement articulaire. Il y a un kyste poplité qui mesure 5,4 cm de long x 3,2 cm dans l’axe antéropostérieur x 2,9 cm dans l’axe transverse.

Le ligament croisé antérieur est normal.

Le ligament collatéral interne est épaissi à sa partie supérieure témoignant d’une ancienne entorse. Il n'y a cependant pas de déchirure significative. 

Le signal de la moelle osseuse est normal.

Il n'y a pas de contusion ni de fracture.

Il n'y a pas de blessure ostéochondrale. 

Il n'y a pas de chondrose ni d’arthrose significative. 

Le reste de l’examen est sans particularité. 

Conclusion :

Il y a une déchirure du ménisque interne qui parait ancienne.

Une consultation en Orthopédie est recommandée pour une opinion. 

Il y a une ancienne entorse du ligament collatéral interne, sans évidence de déchirure.

Autres observations faites; voir rapport plus haut.

Stable looking undersurface horizontal tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with no accompanying medial meniscal extrusion of note, nor is there any involvement of the corresponding posterior root and ligament.

An undisplaced degenerative tear of the free edge of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is again seen, together with lateral meniscal body extrusion.

Focal full-thickness articular cartilage loss noted at the junction between the central and posterior thirds of the lateral femoral condyle, with no accompanying fracture lines or mass lesions, nor any articular surface collapse.

Generalized thinning of medial and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage damage, with focal grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss being centred on the median ridge of the patella.

Moderate suprapatellar effusion, there are no intra-articular bodies.
A high-riding patella is also noted, together with patellofemoral incongruity and subtle superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement - the patellar lateralization present is not deemed secondary to the underlying effusion.

Small, non ruptured Baker's cyst noted posteromedially.

Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, extensor tendons, distal iliotibial band and popliteus musculotendinous unit.

No other skeletal abnormality of note.
Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Medial and lateral meniscal pathology, age commensurate tricompartmental articular degenerative changes, multifactorial extensor mechanism abnormalities.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] female for right knee pain that is functional impairment. Mild OA on x-ray, but pain persistent/worsening.   .

PRIOR IMAGING: Bilateral knee ultrasound [Date].
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism are intact. The patellar cartilage is intact. The trochlear cartilage is intact. The patellar soft tissues normal.

The TT-TG interval measures 5 mm, within normal limits.

The anterior cruciate, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral ligament is complex, including the fibular lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, biceps femoris and popliteus tendons, are intact. No significant anterior tibial translation. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Medial meniscus is intact.  Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Lateral meniscus anterior horn complex radial tear, posterior horn radial tear. Articular cartilage lateral of the femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. 1.5 x 1.5 x 3.9 cm Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal is normal. Soft tissues is normal. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.

INTERPRETATION: 
Lateral meniscus anterior and posterior horn radial tears. Notably, the anterior horn demonstrates a complex radial tear while the posterior horn demonstrates a simple radial tear.

Uniform thinning of the bilateral femoral condyle articular cartilage, likely age-related etiology.

Baker's cyst. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.

As described above Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

None

Trouvailles : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. 
Il y a changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au niveau patellofémoral avec perte de cartilage complet à la facette médiale et à l’apex de la rotule avec changement réactif sous-chondral. Il y a aussi amincissement modéré à la partie médiale et centrale de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a légers changements dégénératifs avec léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et externe sans région de perte complète. 
Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure oblique de la corne postérieure s’étendant à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n’y a pas de fragment méniscal déplacé. Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le ménisque externe avec une déchirure horizontale au niveau du corps. Il y a un important kyste para-méniscal multi-loculé adjacent au corps du ménisque. Le kyste mesure 1.3cm AP x 1.4cm transverse x 2.2cm cranio-caudal. Le kyste se retrouve antérieur au tendon du biceps fémoris distal et au ligament collatéral externe et postérieur à la bandelette ilio-tibiale. 
Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité. 
Conclusion : 
1. Changements dégénératifs modérés plus proéminents au niveau patellofémoral. 
2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance avec déchirure au niveau des ménisques bilatéralement et important kyste para-méniscal du côté latéral tel que mentionné ci-haut. 
3. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.
