Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Chronic atraumatic knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Small tricompartmental marginal osteophytes. Intraosseous ganglion cyst formation along the anterior medial tibial plateau.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with synovitis. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Inner margin tearing of the body segment. Root attachments are intact. No parameniscal cyst.
Medial compartment cartilage: Scattered foci of high-grade cartilage loss along the weightbearing femoral condyle. High-grade cartilage loss at the periphery and anterior aspects of the tibial plateau with underlying subchondral cystic change/edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondrosis along the posterior weightbearing aspect of the femoral condyle along the intercondylar notch. Mild chondrosis along the posterior tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial thickness cartilage thinning along the inferior aspect of the lateral patellar facet with small areas of high-grade fissuring involving the medial facet. Foci of high-grade and full thickness cartilage loss along the medial and central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with some low-grade interstitial tearing along the medial distal fibers.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, mild to moderate in the medial compartment.
2.	Inner margin tearing of the medial meniscal body.
3.	Mild insertional quadriceps tendinosis with some low-grade interstitial tearing.

Bänder/Sehnen/Kapsel/Gelenkraum: Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes. Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Bds. intakte menisceale Aufhängung. Gelenkkapsel nicht verdickt, kein wesentlicher Gelenkerguss. Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. Patellarsehne und Quadricepssehne intakt.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма, структура и сигнален интензитет. Изострена се представя медиалната интеркондиларна еминенция. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус с наличие на хоризонтална хиперинтезна лезия недостигаща ставна повърхност, както при лезия-grade IIa. Нормално изобразяване на преден рог на медиален менискус и на латерален менискус. 
Хрущяла покриващ ставните повърхности и пателата е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Двете кръстни връзки се проследяват до залавните си места с правилна форма и сигнален интензитет. Двата колатерални лигамента са с правилна форма, хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет до залавните им места. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Мастната тъкан на Хофа е с хомогенна структура и сигнален интензитет. Пателата се представя Wiberg II. Insall-Salvati- 0.9. Малък ставен излив. Заключение: МР данни за увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус grade IIa. Малък ставен излив.

MRI of right Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W

* A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst. about 6 cm in length. Mild perifocal fat stranding over medial aspect of right knee
* Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, and unclear contour of meniscal root, in favor of tear.
   No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
* Subchondral abnormal signal foci in medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau, in favor of subchondral cysts.
   Wearing of articualr cartilage of right knee, major at medial femoral condyle and femoral trochlea
* Intermediate signal intensity of PCL on T1WI, R/O grade 1 injury.
* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar,  and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. Mild deep infrapatellar bursitis.
* Mild subcutaneous edema over infrapatellar region.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> The contour of ACL and PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.

Impression:
1. C/W Baker's cyst of the right knee.
2. Osteoarthritis of rigth knee.
3. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
4. Synovitis of right knee with suprapatellar brusitis and patellar plicae 

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Femorotibial der mediale Gelenkspalt etwas verschmälert, ansonsten regelrechte Stellung. Geringes Knochenmarködem in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie am medialen Tibiaplateau (8/27 und 8/26). Schräge Rissbildung im Innenmeniskushinterhorn am Übergang zur Hinterwurzel (6/13 oder 8/29) mit entsprechender Extrusion des Meniskus um bis zu 6 mm. In der Pars intermedia deutliche T2 Signalanhebungen. Entsprechende teils hochgradige Chondropathie an der medialen Femurkondyle über bis zu 10 x 5 mm (7/11 und 8/27). Auch am medialen Tibiaplateau zum Rand hin zunehmende Chondropathie.
Der Außenmeniskus ist intakt. Unauffälliger Knorpelbelag lateralseitig femorotibial.

Hinteres und vorderes Kreuzband intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Hämarthros. Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur. Geringe Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die Subcutis präpatellar.

In the medial compartment, there is posterior root avulsion tear of the medial meniscus. There is minimal displacement of the medial meniscus into the medial gutter. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Posterior root avulsion tear of the medial meniscus, left knee. (note: meniscal extrusion into the medial gutter). 
  Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
  Some amount of left knee effusion.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Dolor anterior rodilla derecha postraumática. Obs. Tendinitis cuadricipital. Obs. Lesión
osteocondral rotuliana.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Cartílago rotuliano con incipientes condropatía superficial difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la inserción distal del tendón
cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano.
Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal.
Discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría
representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

1.	Osseous contusions at the lateral femoral condyle and anterior medial tibial plateau.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the lateral patellar facet and high-grade partial-thickness fissuring at the median ridge. No focal full-thickness defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild to moderate degenerative distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis without superimposed tear.
Patella tendon: Severe patellar tendinosis with superimposed high-grade interstitial tearing of the mid anterior fibers spanning the length of the tendon craniocaudally. No full-thickness component or fiber retraction. Associated prepatellar subcutaneous soft tissue edema.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Diffuse extensor mechanism tendinopathy involving the patellar greater than quadriceps tendon with superimposed partial-thickness interstitial tearing of the patellar tendon. Findings may be related to overuse however given patient clinical history gout should also be considered, although no superimposed osseous erosive change is identified.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala  iliotibijalnog traktusa i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksa ruptura lateralnog meniska u području stražnjeg korijena, s flap komponentom koja se prebacuje anteriorno u području prednjeg roga te u međučvornu udubinu. 
Ruptura meniskofemoralnih ligamenata medijalnog meniska. Korpus meniska povućen je periferno posljedično rupturi medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta pri femoralnoj inserciji. Stražnji križni ligament je edematozan, ali održane napetosti.
Ruptura medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta pri femoralnoj inserciji. U istom području (inferiorno od hvatišta medijalnog patelofemoralnog ligamenta, nalazi se i ruptura zglobne čahure s većim hematomom koji se širi u potkožje promjera do 5,3 cm na aksijalnom presjeku.
Medijalni patelofemoralni ligament inhomnogene je strukture - stanje po njegovoj nepotpunoj rupturi.
Artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Koštani edem apeksa patele, vanjskog aspekta prednje trećine laterlanog kondila femura i posteriornog aspekta platoa tibije.
Opsežan hematizirani izljev u koljenu (hemartros).
Patelarni ligament valovite je konture i edematozan posljedično opsežnom izljevu.
Edem i hematom cirkumferentno u potkožju.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i intenziteta signala.

FINDINGS:

There is a small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There are moderate degenerative changes in the medial compartment with moderate cartilage thinning most pronounced at the central weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is diffuse mild thinning and superficial fraying in the lateral and patellofemoral compartments. There are no regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a longitudinal oblique tear involving the posterior horn extending to the inferior articular surface. There is an intra and para meniscal cyst at the level of the posterior root. There is no displaced meniscal fragment. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Mild to moderate degenerative changes most pronounced in the medial compartment as detailed above. No evidence of intra-articular body.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial meniscus with an oblique tear and para meniscal cyst. No displaced meniscal fragment.

3. Knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

Предният рог на латералния менискус е фрагментиран, като част от него е изместен встрани от ставната междина. Свързана с предния рог на менискуса се изобразява мултилокуларна киста с големина 20/8мм. В тибията, до залавното място на предната кръстна връзка също се намира малка киста, вероятно свързана с описаната по-голяма киста до менискуса. > Wearing of articular cartilage of right knee, especially at patellofemoral joint, with subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia, major at lateral facet.
Increased signal intensity of articular cartilage of lateral tibial plateau on F/S T2WI.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 1 injury.

> Mildly linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impressoin: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee , especially at patellofemoral joint with grade 4 chondromalacia.
2. Synovitis of right knee and patellar plicae.
3. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
4. Baker's cyst.

Diskretno povišenje intenziteta signala pri patelarnom hvatištu patelarnog ligamenta -
entezopatske promjene.

medijalne i lateralne fasete patele uz vidljiv heterogen intenzitet signala lateralne fasete
(hondromalacija I. stupnja) te vidljivu fisuru medijalne fasete patele (hondromalacija II./III.
stupnja).

Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Supkutani edem infrapatelarno.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left posterior knee pain for 7 months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis, most pronounced at the posterior medial femoral condyle. Osteophytes protruding into the intercondylar notch.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. 5 mm intra-articular body at the intercondylar notch. Trace leaking Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tearing with dominant near-complete radial tear of the posterior horn. Severe meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Large areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint and extending to the posterior femoral condyle with associated subchondral signal changes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle near the intercondylar eminence with button osteophyte formation.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Large confluent regions of full-thickness articular cartilage loss at the patella and lateral trochlea with associated subchondral signal changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Severe mucoid degeneration.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 14 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Nonspecific retro-quadriceps fat pad edema.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Medial tibiofemoral compartment and patellofemoral osteoarthritis. Small knee joint effusion with 5 mm intra-articular body at the intercondylar notch.
2.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with dominant radial tear at the posterior horn and severe meniscal extrusion.
3.	Severe mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with a tiny popliteal cysts.

There are mild degenerative changes involving the patellofemoral and lateral compartment with moderate degenerative changes in the medial compartment. There is moderate cartilage thinning involving the central weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with minimal subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is a longitudinal horizontal tear extending from the posterior horn to the body. There is a focal displaced fragment (flap component) arising from the body. The displaced meniscal fragment is located in the medial femoral gutter. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the ACL, the PCL, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Mild to moderate degenerative changes most pronounced in the medial compartment.
2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial meniscus with associated longitudinal horizontal tear and displaced flap component as detailed above.
3. Knee joint effusion with tiny popliteal cyst.

There is a complex degenerative tear through the posterior horn and root of the medial meniscus, with a predominantly radial component, with consequent significant medial extrusion at the level of the body.
There are no accompanying displaced meniscal fragment.

A small subarticular, horizontally oriented fracture line is noted at the medial tibial plateau, with accompanying surrounding marrow oedema like signal change but with no associated articular surface collapse being demonstrated. 
Diffuse grade 2/3 medial weightbearing articular cartilage damage, there is furthermore a moderate suprapatellar effusion that is communicating with a leaking, 5 cm maximal diameter Baker's cyst.

Grossly intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments, a grade 1 superficial MCL sprain is present.
Normal popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons and the distal iliotibial band.

No other skeletal abnormality of note, minor, focal medial retropatellar articular cartilage damage.
Well-maintained remaining patellofemoral and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage surfaces.

Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Unstable complex medial meniscal tear as detailed above, along with insufficiency type bony injury at the medial tibial plateau.
Temporary nonweightbearing advisable in the first instance, together with screening for possible underlying risk factors.

Findings:  Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. No sinister bone marrow changes. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact medial meniscus. Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Minor fibrillation of the hyaline articular cartilage in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. Otherwise well maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus. Possibly represents a small focus of PVNS - patient will be recalled for dedicated sequences.
Exam performed: MR Recall of [DATE]:  Findings:  The previously described small intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus cannot be readily appreciated on the current scan. There are no intra-articular soft tissue foci which demonstrate blooming artefact to suggest PVNS.

Визуализира се вариант в анатомията – трипартидна патела. Артикулиращият ставен хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Нормално представени са предните и задните рога на двата менискуса. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Визуализира се зона на повишен сигнален интензитет в лигамента на пателата (от латералната му страна). По съседство на нея се изобразяват едемни промени в инфрапателарната мастна подложка на Hoffa. Едемни изменени се изобразяват и около латералния пателарен ретинакулум, като в последния се визуализира дефект в близост със залавното му място към пателата. Свързани с него се визуализират малки ганглион кисти. По-голямата от тях пропагира към подкожието и е с р-р 11/3мм. Медиален пателарен ретинакулум – б.о. Малка киста е налице и зад задната кръстна връзка с р-р 7мм. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за пателарна тендиноза (“Jumper’s knee”). Увреда на латералния пателарен ретинакулум. Наличие на малки ганглион кисти, свързани с ретинакулума.  Трипартидна патела.

Minime épanchement intra-articulaire d’allure physiologique. Liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité sans kyste de Baker significatif.

Les ménisques interne et externe sont intacts sans déchirure. Le ménisque externe est légèrement discoïde.

Le ligament collatéral interne, le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe, les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Légère infiltration kystique ganglionnaire au sein du ligament croisé antérieur distal et en intra-osseux sous son insertion distale.

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et aspect légèrement hétérogène avec fissure chondrale superficielle le long du compartiment fémoro-tibial externe en lien avec une légère chondropathie. Foyer de chondropathie focale sévère le long de la surface portante du condyle fémoral interne avec fissure chondrale transfixiante et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels.

L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Les tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire sont intacts sans déchirure. Légère tendinose du tendon patellaire proximal. Légère chondropathie diffuse au compartiment patellofémoral avec fibrillation chondrale superficielle et fissures plus marquées, partielle, le long de la facette patellaire externe et transfixiante le long de la facette patellaire interne avec début de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels, en lien avec des foyers de chondropathie respectivement modéré sévère.

Conclusion :

Il n’y a pas de dérangement interne (pas de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire significative). 

Pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. 

Légère chondropathie tricompartimentale avec foyer de chondropathie focale sévère le long de la surface portante du condyle fémoral interne et le long de la facette patellaire interne.

Full-thickness chondral loss along the weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle with underlying bone stress change. High-grade chondral thinning is also noted in the medial tibial condyle. Relatively well-maintained lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Full-thickness rupture of the ACL at the femoral attachment. Complex tearing of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with displaced meniscal fragments extending posteriorly, adjacent to the tibial attachment of the PCL. Severe medial tibiofemoral degenerative changes.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Bilateral inner knee pain for several years.
Comparison: Knee radiographs dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal morphology with mild intrasubstance myxoid degeneration. No medial meniscus tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle. Cartilage on the medial tibial plateau is preserved.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
There is moderate grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the patellar median ridge, with mild chondral fissuring at the medial and lateral patellar facets.
Mild chondral edema and heterogeneity at the femoral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild insertional quadriceps tendinosis with intrasubstance degeneration at its medial margin attachment to the patella. No tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2.	Mild insertional quadriceps tendinosis.

* Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
* Subcutaneous edema around knee, more prominent at lateral side.
* Muscle and intermuscular infiltration over left popliteal fossa, in favor of muscle and intermusclar edema.
* Deep infrapatellar bursitis.
* Thickening of iliotibial band and quadriceps tendon, in favor of tendinosis.

1. C/W tear of PCL and avulsion fracture of PCL with bone marrow edema in proximal tibia. 
2. Osteoarthritis of left knee.
3. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar bursitis and deep infrapatellar bursitis; patellar plicae.
3. Subcutaneous edema around left knee and muscle and intermuscular edema over popliteal fossa. Mild popliteus and Anserine bursitis.
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
5. Bone contusion over left proximal tibia.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Il y a un signal normal de la moelle osseuse. Il n'y a pas de fracture ou de contusion. Il y a un léger amincissement du cartilage impliquant les trois compartiments sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstances impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure longitudinale d'orientation horizontale s'étendant de la corne postérieure, jusqu'au niveau du corps du ménisque interne. La déchirure s'étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il y a un petit kyste paraméniscal millimétrique adjacent à la corne postérieure et au corps. Il n'y a pas de fragment déplacé. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Rotule sans particularité sans fracture ou contusion. Légers changements dégénératifs des trois compartiments.

2- Changements dégénératifs intrasubstances du ménisque interne avec une déchirure horizontale telle que détaillée ci-haut.

Вътреставните фрагметни за разположени интеркондиларно и доразлно до ставната капсула. Наличие на осификации по ставната капсула в близост до двата епикондили на бедрената кост, най-вероятно във връзка с хематома. Няма данни за фрактури на по хода на фибулата, пателата и фемура. МР данни за изразен костномозъчен едем в тибията във връзка с фрактурата. Едем на меките тъкани около колянната става. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус, като той е фрагментиран. Частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент на залавното му за фемура място. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. original_report: МР находка: Наличие на малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална структура. Вижда се ограничена зона на контузионен костномозъчен едем дорзално в епифизата на медиалното тибиално плато. Сред мастната подложка на Hoffa, зад лигамента на пателата се изобразява овална структура с р-р 10/3,5мм. Находката е с костна структура и съответства на вътреставно свободно тяло. Втора лезия със сходна макроморфология се изобразява и пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Визуализира се остеохондрален дефект по предната повърхност на медиалния кондил на фемура. Дефектът в хрущяла съответства по форма на описаното свободно тяло пред медиалния кондил на фемура. Наличие на начални, минимални остеофити по ставните повърхности на медиалните кондили на фемура и тибията. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. МР данни за руптура на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Свързани с менискуса се изобразяват множество перименискални малки кисти. Дегенеративно променен латерален менискус. Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Lateral knee pain.
Comparison: Right knee radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytosis.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Small leaking Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear involving the body, posterior horn and posterior root, noting a complete radial tear at the posterior root. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade articular cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss/fissuring and associated subchondral signal changes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint in the lateral joint line.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade articular cartilage loss throughout the patella with areas of full-thickness loss at the median ridge and medial facet with associated subchondral signal changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior right knee pain. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Bone marrow edema identified in the patella which appears related to full-thickness chondrosis. There are tricompartment marginal osteophytes. 
Alignment is anatomic.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE: 
Intra-articular body deep to the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Small joint effusion. No Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complex tear of the meniscus with partial tearing of the posterior root, maceration of the posterior horn, and undersurface tearing body. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss posterior weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with no tear. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Small areas of full-thickness cartilage loss on both sides of the joint. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Denudation of cartilage of the lateral patellar facet and median ridge. Full thickness cartilage loss of the lateral trochlea. Heterogeneity of the medial patellar facet and medial trochlea cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 23 mm. Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. 
No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.  

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartment osteoarthritis including marginal osteophytes, chondrosis and bone marrow edema in the patella.
2.	Extensive complex medial meniscus tear with full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial tibiofemoral compartment.
3.	Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. 3 mm intra-articular body posterior to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Large Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique radial tear of the posterior horn/root of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion. There is degenerative signal within the meniscal body.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild loss of cartilage along the posterior medial femoral condyle with small subchondral cysts and marrow edema. There is mild subchondral marrow edema in the medial portion of the medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: 10 mm full thickness cartilage defect in the central femoral trochlea with subchondral marrow edema. Minimal subchondral marrow edema at the median ridge of the patella.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact. Edema signal surrounds the ligament.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 6 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Oblique radial tear of the posterior horn/root of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion.
2. Patellofemoral osteoarthritis with full thickness cartilage defect in the central femoral trochlea.
3. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.
4. Moderate knee joint effusion and large Baker's cyst.

Виждат се остеофитни наслоявания на пателата – супратрохлеарно вляво, като същата е сублуксирана в латерално направление. Ставният хрущял на фемуропателарната става е изтънен с наличие на ерозии на хрущяла на пателата и малки субхондрални костни кисти по задния и ръб с перифокален едем по съседство. Дефект с кос ход, на късо протежение в хрущяла на медиалния кондил на десния фемур в зоната на максимално натоварване, без подлежаща субхондрална костна лезия. Субхондрални костни кисти „геоди“ се изобразяват под интеркондиларните еминенции, които са изострени. Подобни малки кисти се виждат и на нивото на тибиофибуларната става.  Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Визуализират се дегенеративни промени в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. МР данни за начални дегенеративни промени в лявата колянна става. Визуализират се малки остеофити по ставните краища на фемура и тибията, предимно на медиалните кондили.  Интеркондиларните еминенции са изострени. Наличие на остеохондрален дефект в предната половина на медиалния кондил на фемура с обширен костномозъчен едем, извън зоната на максимално натоварване. Вижда се дефект в подлежащия ставен хрущял на това ниво. В останалите си отдели артикулиращият ставен хрущял на на тибията и фемура е със запазена конгруентност, лекостепенно изтънен.  Предната кръстна връзка е със запазена цялост. Задна кръстна връзка – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус при начални дегенеративни промени в задния му рог. Визуализира се руптура с хоризонтален към кос ход в задния рог на медиалния менискус – степен 2b. Колатерални лигаменти - нормално изобразяване на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Дегенеративни промени в залавните места на латералния колатерален лигамент, който е със запазена цялост.  Пателата е с белези на хондрмалация. Вижда се малък дефект срединно в хрущяла на ставния хрущял в областта на горния полюс в съчетание с едемни субхондрални промени в прилежащата задна стена на пателата. Находката съответства на ходромалация – IV степен по Outerbridge grading system. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани. Заключение: Дясна колянна става: МР данни за трохлеарна дисплазия – тип В по Dejour. Латерална сублуксация на пателата. Начални гонартрозни промени с хондромалация на пателата.

Лява колянна става: МР данни за гонартроза. Остеохондрален дефект в медиален кондил на фемура. Хондромалация на пателата -  IV степен по Outerbridge. Лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2b степен.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] with chronic left knee pain, ultrasound unable to visualize medial collateral ligament. Please note that at the time of the exam the patient insisted that the symptoms were on the right knee not the left and for this reason the right knee was scanned.   .

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. Patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. There is prepatellar edema demonstrated anterior to the patella with some fluid in the prepatellar bursa and pretibial bursa consistent with pretibial bursitis.

The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is reasonably well-maintained.

The TT-TG distance measures about 1 cm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained. There is very early degenerative osteophytic spurring seen along the lateral joint margin.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained. Mild medial compartment degenerative osteophyte formation is seen particularly at the condylar notch.

The anterior cruciate ligament is intact and unremarkable.

The posterior cruciate ligament is intact and unremarkable.

The medial collateral ligament is intact and appears unremarkable.

The lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small to moderate Baker's cyst demonstrated.

There is no evidence of a significant knee effusion. There is a small parameniscal cyst unassociated with a definite meniscal tear situated near the posterior root attachment of the medial meniscus measuring about 1.1 x 0.4 x 1.3 cm.

Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

There is edema in the pretibial and prepatellar soft tissues consistent with prepatellar bursitis.

There is a Baker's cyst.

There are early degenerative changes seen to the lateral and medial joint compartments.

U području medijalnog kondila femura opsežni koštani edem s blagim konkavitetom kortikalisa
sprijeda što može ići u prilog rane faze spontalne osteonekroze koljena (SONK).
Zone hondromalacije II. stupnja tibijalne, kondilarne i patelarne hrskaice, te III. stupnja
trohlearne hrskavice centralno.
M. vastus medialis je niže položen, s manjim zonama edema u području distalne trećine -
parcijalna ruptura?
Distenzija medijalnog patelarnog retinakuluma s rupturom u kaudalnom dijelu.
Distenzija medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta, uz moguću parcijalnu rupturu meniskofemoralnog
ligamenta (unutarnji sloj vlakana).
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je entezopatski promijenjen na femoralnom hvatištu, održanog
kontinuiteta.
Povišeni intenzitet signala u području stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska s vidljivom kosom
rupturom.
Inhomogeniji je izgled femoralnog hvatišta medijalne glave m. gastrocnemius, moguće
posljedično okolnom edemu ili u sklopu deg. promjena.
Edem tetive m. semimebranosus - moguća manja parcijalna ruptura.
Umjerena količina izljeva u zglobu.
Edem potkožnog masnog tkiva medijalno.
Lateralni menisk je primjerenih intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Prednji križni ligament je promijenjenog intenziteta signala u distalnoj trećini uz prekid

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Primary osteoarthritis right knee
Comparison: Radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear anterior horn and body lateral meniscus.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness cartilage defect anterior and central weightbearing aspect lateral femoral condyle and reciprocal cartilage loss within the lateral tibial plateau with femoral condyle greater than tibial plateau reactive subchondral marrow edema like changes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Partial thickness cartilage fissure lateral patellar facet. Near full-thickness cartilage fissure medial patellar facet superiorly just medial to the median ridge patella.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Marked thickening of the distal quadriceps tendon with intrasubstance fluid signal consistent with partial thickness tearing of the central deep hemorrhage encompassing less than 40% of the tendon thickness.
Patella tendon: Mild tendinopathy without tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Complex tear anterior horn and body lateral meniscus with adjacent full-thickness cartilage loss and subchondral reactive marrow changes.

Marked tendinopathy of the distal quadriceps tendon with moderate grade intrasubstance partial thickness tearing of the central deep fibers.

Moderate size joint effusion with moderate partially ruptured popliteal cyst.

Anterior translation of the tibia in reference to the femur. Osseous contusions along the lateral femoral condyle terminal sulcus, posterior lateral tibial plateau and peripheral medial femoral condyle. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

Moderate hemarthrosis. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete tear of the proximal to midsubstance ACL. 
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 MCL sprain. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 1 sprain of the fibular collateral ligament. 
Posterolateral corner structures: As above.

Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Grade 1 strain of the proximal popliteus muscle. No muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Edema along the posterolateral subcutaneous tissues.

IMPRESSION:
Findings compatible with acute pivot shift injury, including:

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: Radiograph [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Abnormal linear hyperintense signal in the body and posterior horn of the meniscus extending obliquely to the tibial articular surface with additional vertical components along the undersurface of the posterior horn there is a small displaced oblique fragment along the free edge of the body/posterior horn (series 7001, image 9 and series 6001, images 6 and 7).
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild loss of cartilage along the medial femoral condyle with minimal subchondral marrow edema. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness loss of cartilage at the junction of the medial and lateral patellar facets and partial-thickness loss of cartilage along the medial portion of the lateral patellar facet with small foci of subchondral marrow edema. There is moderate loss of cartilage in the central/medial femoral trochlea. Small marginal osteophytes are noted in the patellofemoral joint compartment.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Imaged tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
2. Moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis and mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.
3. Small knee joint effusion.

Indication: Pain.

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is moderate bone marrow edema within the medial tibial epimetaphysis, with areas of linear low signal consistent with stress fracture. Background bone marrow signal is normal. 

JOINT SPACE:
Minimal joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate to severe cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet, with areas of full-thickness fissuring and minimal subchondral cystic change. Mild cartilage surface irregularity is present at the medial patellar facet. Trochlear cartilage appears intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinosis with interstitial tearing at the patellar attachment.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is mild lateral patellar subluxation, suggesting underlying patellar maltracking. Borderline patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Stress fracture at the medial aspect of the proximal tibia.

2. Patellofemoral chondrosis with evidence of underlying patellar maltracking.

3. Mild quadriceps tendinosis with interstitial tearing.

4. Minimal Baker cyst.

3. Marrow contusions involving the anterior aspect of the medial and lateral tibial plateau.

Collateral ligaments: Intact

Extensor mechanism: Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Joint fluid/Baker's cyst: There is a small to moderate joint effusion. There is also a moderate complex Baker's cyst which appears partially ruptured.

Mild cartilage thinning and heterogeneity are noted in the weightbearing aspect of the lateral compartment.

Patellofemoral joint: There is mild cartilage heterogeneity along the posterior patella.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Prior right knee meniscal and medial collateral ligament injury with prior arthroscopy. Recurrent right knee pain, limping, swelling.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending to the body, which is peripherally extruded. There is irregular contour of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus, consistent with superimposed complex tear. There is apical truncation of the medial meniscal body consistent with a superimposed partial radial tear. The anterior horn and posterior root are intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Moderate popliteus tendinosis without tear. Fibular collateral ligament is intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact.

There is slight medial patellar subluxation. The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 14 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the medial patellar facet and fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the central to lateral femoral trochlea. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding medial femoral trochlea. There is fissuring and thinning of medial femorotibial articular cartilage along the inferior aspect. There is mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Small knee joint effusion. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tearing of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with medial meniscal extrusion, as described.
2. Intact medial collateral ligament.
3. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
4. Mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the patellofemoral and medial femorotibial compartments consistent with mild to moderate osteoarthritis of the right knee.

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

translaciju za oko 10 mm.
Subtotalna ruptura medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta koja se koso pruža kroz vlakna ligamenta.
Parcijalna ruptura lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Parcijalna ruptura iliotibijalnog traktusa pri tibijalnom hvatištu uz edem mekih tkiva uz LCL
kompleks.
Uredna je morfologija i intenziteti signala stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, patelarnog ligamenta i
tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Medijalni menisk je promijenjene morfologije i intenziteta signala, moguće u sklopu

meniska - kontuzija uz horizontalnu rupturu prednjeg roga i dijela tijela lateralnog meniska koja
prelazi femoralnu zglobnu plohu.
Parcijalna ruptura prednjeg korijena lateralnog meniska.

polumjesečasto oblikovan hipointenzivni supstrat 7 mm - hemoragija? fragment meniska?
Artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Izljev u koljenu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste. Manja količina lokulirane tekućine uz
tetive pes anserius.
Opsežan supkutani edem čitavog koljenog zgloba.

intenziteta signala.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Suspected medial meniscal tear right knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:[

The medial meniscus is intact with the lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon insertion, and iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 14 mm, within normal limits. No patellofemoral subluxation. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the lateral femoral trochlea. The remainder of the patellofemoral articular cartilage is preserved. The medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage is preserved.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. 

IMPRESSION:

No internal derangement. Tiny focus of high-grade chondrosis in the patellofemoral compartment. Otherwise unremarkable study.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Radial tear at the posterior root.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the patella.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Shallow trochlear groove. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 4 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Focal radial tear at the medial meniscus posterior root.
2.	Mild tricompartmental chondrosis. Small knee joint effusion with mild synovitis. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.
3.	Superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement, suggesting lateral patellofemoral maltracking.

Interprétation:

Petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Il n'y a pas de kyste de Baker significatif. 

Il y a de légères anomalies de signal iso-intense au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suggérant des changements mucoïdes dégénératifs. Il n'y a pas déchirure au ménisque interne notée. 

Il y a un léger épaississement du ligament collatéral interne avec un léger oedème au pourtour, en lien avec une entorse de grade I. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne en lien avec une légère chondropathie. Il n'y a pas d'atteinte transfixiante ou changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé.

Déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque externe avec déchirure longitudinale horizontale s'étendant de la jonction de la corne postérieure et du corps méniscal à la corne antérieure de même qu'un aspect macéré à la jonction de la corne antérieure et de la racine antérieure. 

Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. Légère délamination à la jonction du tendon du biceps femoris et du ligament fibulo-collatéral.

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoral-tibial interne en lien avec une légère chondropathie. Foyer de chondropathie de grade III à la surface non portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes notées sans changement sous-chondral réactionnel associé.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure.

L'alignement patello-fémoral paraît dans les limites normales. Enthésophyte à l'insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et à l'origine du tendon patellaire avec légère enthésopathie et tendinose. Il n'y a pas de déchirure. 

Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral en lien avec une légère chondropathie. 

Conclusion:

Déchirure légère complexe du ménisque externe avec composante principale longitudinale horizontale, telle que détaillée ci-haut.

Entorse de grade I du ligament collatéral interne.

Légère chondropathie tricompartimentale diffuse avec foyer de chondropathie de grade III, le long de la surface non portante au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe.

Налице е обособен костен фрагмент в областта на туберозитас тибие, най-вероятно във връзка с болест на „Osgood-Schlatter”. Няма костномозъчен едем при този фрагмент или перифокално възпаление. Визуализира се увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 степен. В него се изобразява в хиперинтензна лезия, достигаща ставната повърхност на тибията. MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear of the body and posterior horn, mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Trochlear cartilage is maintained. Full thickness cartilage loss of the lateral patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral edema and cystic changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Mild degeneration of the lateral head of the gastrocnemius origin. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Oblique undersurface tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion.

2. Areas of full-thickness patellar chondrosis.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic with exception of the patella. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Remodeling/flattening of the anterolateral distal femur.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: No tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade chondral fissuring and small area of delamination at the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar subluxation. Patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 28 mm, increased.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Progressive lateral patellar subluxation with secondary findings of lateral patellar maltracking, including superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement, patella alta, patellofemoral chondrosis, and chronic remodeling of the distal anterolateral femur. Increased TT-TG distance of 28 mm.
2.	No discrete MPFL or medial patellar retinaculum injury. However, the progressive patellar subluxation indicates some degree of MPFL/medial retinaculum deficiency.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 5 to 6 months of aching sharp constant pain at the front of the knee
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn and body with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage thinning in the central weightbearing femoral condyle and reciprocal tibial surface.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal cartilage fissuring at the medial patellar facet adjacent to the median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with dominant horizontal oblique component. Mild extrusion and displacement into the meniscotibial recess.

2. Moderate medial compartment and minimal patellofemoral chondrosis.

3. Probable lateral patellofemoral maltracking with impingement of Hoffa's fat.

4. Small Baker's cyst.

MRI LEFT KNEE  (plain)

Clinical information:
History of left knee giving out

Technique: 
Multiplanar MR of the knee according to protocol.

Comparison: 
None

Findings: 

Menisci

Lateral meniscus: No surfacing hyperintensity of the posterior horn is probably due to intrasubstance degeneration. No definite meniscal tear detected. No para meniscal cyst.

Medial meniscus: intact

Ligaments

Anterior cruciate ligament: Chronic complete tear with anterior tibial translation of approximately 1.0 cm.

Posterior cruciate ligament: intact but buckled from the anterior tibial translation.

Medial collateral ligament: Superficial and deep components intact. No periligamentous edema.

Lateral collateral ligament: The iliotibial band, biceps femoris tendon, fibular collateral ligament and popliteus muscle and tendon intact. 

Posterolateral corner structures: Intact

Extensor Mechanism

The distal quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. The patella is normally positioned within the femoral groove. There is no retinacular disruption.

Fluid

No joint effusion or loose body. Trace Baker's cyst.

Osseous and Articular Structures

Bones: No fracture, stress reaction, or osseous lesion is seen.

Patellofemoral compartment: Minimal chondrosis.

Medial compartment: Minimal chondrosis.

Lateral compartment: Up to severe chondral loss at the tibial plateau with chondral fissures and subchondral edema.

Others:

Hoffa's fat pad: clear

Muscles: No abnormal oedema. 

Neurovascular bundle: Normal 


COMMENT
Full-thickness chronic tear of the anterior cruciate ligament resulting in anterior tibial translation approximately 1 cm. Posterior cruciate ligament is intact but is buckled from the anterior tibial translation.

Up to severe chondrosis at the lateral tibiofemoral compartment with full-thickness chondral fissures and loss at the lateral tibial plateau associated subchondral edema.

Il n'y a pas de signe de complication.

Il y a de légers changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémorotibial interne avec fissures chondrales superficielles, une atténuation chondrale, en particulier à la surface portante, et de petits ostéophytes marginaux. Il y a un nouveau petit foyer d’œdème non-spécifique au plateau tibial postéro-interne, au versant plus central, non-spécifique. Il n'y a pas de trait fracturaire ni d’impaction trabéculaire noté. Il pourrait s’agir d’une petite contusion osseuse ou des changements réactionnels en lien avec l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur à proximité. 

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact et sans déchirure.

Le ménisque externe est inchangé, sans déchirure notée. Il y a de minimes changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémorotibial externe avec une légère atténuation chondrale et des ébauches ostéophytiques aux marges articulaires. 

Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact et sans déchirure.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts et sans déchirure. À nouveau, il y a un petit kyste intra-osseux ganglionnaire sous l’insertion au niveau des épines tibiales. 

Il y a des nouveaux foyers de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels aux deux versants de l’articulation tibiofibulaire proximal, le plus probablement de nature dégénérative. 

Il y a, à nouveau, une bascule/subluxation externe de la rotule de même que de larges enthésophytes/ossifications à l’origine du tendon patellaire. Il y a une légère progression d’un épaississement marqué diffus du tendon patellaire, en particulier au tiers proximal, compatible avec une tendinose sévère sous-jacente. Dans l’intervalle, il y a une nouvelle déchirure partielle, intra-substance focale proximale à l’origine du tendon patellaire sous le pôle inférieur de la rotule, avec un léger déplacement caudal d’une ossification, potentiellement de nature avulsive. Celle-ci parait de grade intermédiaire à important, impliquant plus de 50% de l’épaisseur tendineuse à l’origine du tendon, dont la composante principale mesure environ 11 x 12 x 10 mm. 

La déchirure intrasubstance partielle précédemment décrite à l’insertion distale impliquant les fibres profondes du tendon patellaire parait résolue avec principalement une tendinose résiduelle distalement. 

Il y a un léger œdème réactionnel au pôle inférieur de la rotule. Il y a aussi une infiltration associée de la graisse de Hoffa. 

Il y a un minime épaississement prépatellaire et infrapatellaire résiduel, sans franche composante de bursite à l’étude actuelle. 

Par ailleurs, il y a de légers changements dégénératifs au compartiment patellofémoral avec fissures chondrales superficielles. Ceci est plus marqué à l’apex patellaire et à la facette patellaire externe avec de petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Le tendon du quadriceps distal est intact et sans déchirure. 

Conclusion :

Il y a légère progression d’une tendinose déjà sévère impliquant le tendon patellaire, particulièrement à son tiers proximal, telle que décrite ci-haut, avec principalement une nouvelle déchirure partielle focale potentiellement de type avulsive et de grade intermédiaire à important à son origine sous le pôle inférieur de la rotule telle que décrite ci-haut. Il y a un léger œdème réactionnel au pôle inférieur de la rotule. 

Il y a résolution dans l'intervalle d’une déchirure précédemment décrite distalement au sein du tendon patellaire.

Il y a de nouveaux foyers de changements sous-chondraux réactionnels à l’articulation tibiofibulaire proximale, probablement de nature dégénérative de même qu’une petite contusion osseuse versus changements réactionnels au versant postérieur légèrement central du plateau tibial interne tels que détaillés ci-haut.
